jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer, Customer Agents
jobs.description: **About Attuned Intelligence** ------------------------------ Attuned Intelligence is automating patient access for community health centers and health systems. We build AI\-powered voice agents that automate how patients enter, navigate, and stay connected to care — from the first phone call to a scheduled visit. Every missed call at a health center is a missed appointment. Every language barrier is a gap in care. We exist to close those gaps. Our platform handles hundreds of thousands of calls per month across multiple languages, routing patients to the right care team on the first try — and integrating directly with Epic to automate scheduling, appointment management, and clinical workflows. We're a fast\-moving team backed by a deep understanding of agentic systems and healthcare operations with a mission\-driven approach to building technology that makes care more accessible and equitable. **The role** ------------ We're looking for a hands\-on AI solutions engineer to build and improve agents for our healthcare customers. You'll translate requirements gathered by the Customer Delivery team into reliable agent capabilities, developing prompts, conversation flows, and tool integrations that improve patient access and reduce administrative work. Partnering with platform engineers, you'll prototype new capabilities, test the complete experience, and turn recurring customer needs into reusable solutions across the Attuned platform. Success means customers have reliable agents, know how to use them effectively, and can see measurable improvements in their operations. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build and validate customer solutions.** Design prompts, conversation flows, knowledge content, and tool integrations. Test complete experiences against realistic scenarios and customer expectations. * **Develop new agent capabilities.** Translate customer problems into new agent behaviors, tools, and workflows. Prototype and validate solutions, building directly where appropriate and partnering with platform engineers on capabilities that require product or infrastructure changes. * **Test and troubleshoot systematically.** Develop scalable testing systems that can run representative customer scenarios. Reproduce failures, distinguish prompt and configuration issues from model or platform problems, and verify that changes improve the intended behavior. * **Drive ongoing customer outcomes.** Use call results and feedback gathered by Customer Delivery to recommend and implement agent improvements and identify opportunities to expand the agent's usefulness. Measure progress through successful task completion, patient experience, and reduced staff effort while preserving privacy and appropriate human handoffs. * **Turn customer learning into product improvements.** Identify needs shared across customers and contribute reusable capabilities, implementation approaches, and recommendations for the product roadmap. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 3\-5 years experience with hands\-on experience building LLM\-based agents, conversational experiences, or workflow automations, with concrete examples of what you built and how you tested it. * Experience with voice AI, conversation design, speech recognition, or text\-to\-speech systems. * Strong writing and structured reasoning: you can turn an ambiguous request into clear instructions, decision logic, and observable success criteria. * Practical programming or scripting ability, plus comfort working with APIs, JSON, version control, and logs to build and debug workflows. * A methodical approach to troubleshooting. You investigate what happened, reproduce the problem, and validate the fix against the actual user experience. * Clear communication with technical and nontechnical teammates, including explaining dependencies and surfacing missing requirements early. **Helpful experience** ---------------------- * Agent tool calling, evaluation frameworks, or automated scenario testing. * Customer implementations, technical support, or another role that translates real\-world operating requirements into working software.

jobs.description: **Account Executive, Public Sector** **Autessa Inc. \| Redmond, WA \| Full\-time, in\-office** **About Autessa** Autessa is an AI Infrastructure company in Redmond, WA. The Autessa Platform helps organizations safely build, deploy, monitor and scale complex AI systems in production. We are bringing the platform to Washington State and local government, backed by an independently validated compliance foundation including ISO 42001 and SOC 2 Type II. This is a chance to grow and develop expertise at the front of applied AI and solve real operational challenges. **The role** The Account Executive owns the full sales cycle for Washington State and local government agencies, from initial engagement through close. You will be supported by the Chief Commercial Officer on account strategy, solution design, presentations, proposals, and negotiations, with the access and involvement to develop quickly into a senior public sector account executive. This is a full\-time, in\-office role based in Redmond, WA. **Responsibilities** * Run outreach campaigns that introduce Autessa to agency leaders * Meet agency staff through client and partner introductions, briefings, and on\-site visits * Represent Autessa at government conferences and industry events * Learn how an agency's work gets done today and where AI can reduce the workload * Understand each agency's decision\-making, budget, and approval process * Scope each engagement with the Chief Commercial Officer and our engineers, and write the proposal * Respond to RFPs and work through cooperative purchasing contracts * Manage opportunities that come through reseller partners * Support implementation: coordinate between agency staff and our engineers, track progress, and resolve issues until the system is in use **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of full\-cycle sales experience, including consultative sales with multiple stakeholders and long approval cycles * A record of meeting or exceeding quota * Experience building your own pipeline through outbound prospecting * Clear, concise, and effective communication in conversation, by email, and in formal documents such as proposals * Preferred: experience selling to government or other regulated buyers, including RFP responses **Compensation and benefits** * $75,000 base salary plus commission, $150,000 on\-target earnings (OTE) * Unlimited PTO * Health, dental, vision, and life insurance * Weekly company BBQ, team lunches, and regular team events and offsites Autessa is an equal opportunity employer. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: If you thrive in fast paced environments, enjoy hands\-on problem solving, and want to make a measurable impact while working with modern automation and control systems, this role offers the challenge, autonomy, and growth opportunities to take your engineering career to the next level. In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print ‑and ‑apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities. What You’ll Do * Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety. * Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package. * Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on\-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed. * Inspect systems to ensure the operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieve operational conditions prescribed by the client. * Oversee scope of development, work request initiation, scheduling, and inspection of work performed by outside contractors, which includes proprietary work, licensed installations, upgrades, and maintenance and inspection of specialized systems. * Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation. * Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS\-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems. * Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies. * Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts. * Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents. * Perform controls systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability. * Clearly communicate technical issues, project timelines, and product impacts with site leadership, operations and maintenance teams. * Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members. * Perform other job\-related duties as needed or assigned. What You’ll Need * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. * Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2\-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered. * Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming. * 2\+ years of experience working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA\-based monitoring and control systems. * Ability to be available and work in a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays. * Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight. * Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more. * Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems. Preferred Qualifications * 2\+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming. * Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems. * Experience with robotic maintenance. * In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc. * Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset. * Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial\-related calculations. You should be proficient in: * PLC Programming Experience * SCADA Experience Machines \& technologies you'll use: * Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) (Allen Bradley)

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Simulations
jobs.description: **About Rune** Rune Technologies builds mission\-critical software for military logistics and sustainment. Our flagship product is TyrOS, an AI\-enabled logistics command and control platform that gives commanders a single, real\-time operating picture of their sustainment fight, from inventory and distribution to medical and operational planning, even in degraded and contested environments. We're not a traditional defense contractor. We're a small, fast\-moving team that combines deep operational experience in and with the DoD with the software discipline of the best product companies, and we apply that combination to a customer set that desperately needs it. We stay close to our users by embedding directly with military units during exercises and rotations, and we ship constantly based on what we learn. The U.S. military and its allies face a real logistics modernization problem. We're building the software to solve it. **About the Role** At Rune Technologies, we are building the logistics technology backbone that the U.S. and allied militaries need to dominate in large\-scale combat operations. As a Backend Software Engineer at Rune, you will be part of a high\-impact team working at the intersection of advanced logistics algorithms, modern AI\-enabled software, and complex system integrations — all in support of the warfighter at the tactical edge. You'll join us in our mission to bring 21st\-century software to the sustainment domain: modernizing inventory management, transportation optimization, and predictive planning with state\-of\-the\-art user experiences. You'll work closely with a team of experienced engineers, product designers, and operational experts who care deeply about delivering real\-world impact. As our Backend Software Engineer for Simulations, you will own the simulations workstream within TyrOS, working closely with our forecaster lead and the broader platform team. The primary focus is Rune's forecasting system, building the production software that models, predicts, and reasons about logistics outcomes in complex operational environments. This role calls for a strong software engineer who is also mathematically and scientifically fluent: someone who can work in formulas, reason about physical systems, and build production\-quality software around that reasoning. **What You'll Do** * Build and own production\-grade simulation and forecasting software, with a primary focus on Rune's logistics forecaster. * Work with mathematical models, numerical methods, and scientific formulas to implement software where correctness is defined by the underlying physics or math, not just user acceptance. * Collaborate closely with the forecaster lead and platform team to integrate simulation capabilities into TyrOS workflows. * Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, contributing to a culture of engineering rigor and mission focus. * Triage and debug issues in production, ensuring reliability and rapid iteration in support of operational needs. * Work closely with engineers, product managers, and military stakeholders to ensure simulation and forecasting systems meet real\-world sustainment requirements. **Qualifications** * 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, with demonstrated experience building software in a scientific or mathematically complex domain: sensor algorithms, motion planning, simulation, forecasting, or similar. * Ability to work with mathematical models and numerical methods in code; comfort reasoning about correctness in terms of physics or math, not just software behavior. * Proficiency in Python, C\+\+, or Go. * Strong software engineering foundation \- this role requires production\-quality engineering, not analysis or research. * Math or science background, through degree, graduate work, or professional domain experience. * Strong sense of ownership and a bias for action. **Desired Qualifications** * Experience at a defense\-adjacent autonomous systems company in a hands\-on engineering capacity * Degree or graduate degree in a scientific field such as physics, applied mathematics, aerospace, or mechanical engineering. * Familiarity with numerical simulation frameworks or scientific computing libraries. * Experience deploying software to production environments, including cloud (AWS, Kubernetes) and edge infrastructure. **Benefits** Rune offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees to include a full suite of insurance options at no cost for employees and low\-cost to spouses and dependents. Highly competitive equity grants are also included in the majority of full time offers and are considered part of Rune's total compensation package. Benefits include: * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans; premiums 100% covered by Rune for all employees; exceptionally low premiums for spouses and dependents * Basic life insurance and disability 100% covered for all employees by Rune; option to purchase additional life insurance available * ‘Take the time off that you need, when you need it’ paid time off, not accrual based * Generous company holiday calendar including a holiday shutdown in December * Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service, medical events, and parental leave * Full 401(k) retirement plan for all full\-time eligible employees * Company\-funded commuter benefits * Free access to on\-site gym at office Compensation Range: $190K \- $210K

jobs.title: Data Engineer (SQL)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will design and build the data layer for a federal enterprise platform. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you taking responsibility for the accuracy and performance of your assigned components. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Design database schemas, and write the views, stored procedures, functions, and Structured Query Language (SQL) queries that run on them. * Build and maintain data pipelines and extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT) processes, including loads from Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\). * Make queries and databases fast enough for high\-volume workloads. * Help model data across Amazon Web Services (AWS) stores such as Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), Amazon DynamoDB, and S3\. * Keep data accurate and secure, with governed access and changes that can be audited. * Work out data access patterns and integrations with developers, architects, and data engineers. * Where the work allows, use artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted tools for query, pipeline, and troubleshooting work, and review and validate what they produce. You deliver database components accurate and fast enough that analysts and systems trust them. You automate the loads and checks that used to be run by hand, and you build models that keep working as the platform grows. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of data engineering, database development, database engineering, software development, or comparable practical experience * Bachelor's degree * Working expertise in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), covering schema design, stored procedures and functions, and indexing * Experience with Amazon DynamoDB, covering data modeling and Global and Local Secondary Indexes (GSIs and LSIs) * SQL skills across complex queries, views, stored procedures, and functions, together with relational design, normalization, and data modeling * Performance and query tuning that addresses slow queries through indexing and execution\-plan work * ETL and ELT development and data integration across AWS data services such as Aurora, DynamoDB, and S3 * Experience working within data security controls such as encryption, access management, and auditing * Experience loading data from S3 into the platform stores and connecting through Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) * Experience making logical data modeling and database\-design decisions for assigned components within an established platform architecture * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * An AWS certification at the associate level, such as Developer Associate or Solutions Architect Associate * Experience tuning queries that involve locking and deadlocks * Familiarity with supporting cloud\-native applications in AWS through continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) practices * Ownership of physical design for Aurora and DynamoDB schemas and indexes, or the drive to grow into it * Experience in federal information technology or high\-volume transaction environments * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tools **Who you are** You enjoy building with SQL and take responsibility for getting data right. You can take a database problem from design through delivery and stand behind how your work performs. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Solid SQL on a modern relational platform, Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible), with stored procedures, functions, and views that hold up in use. * Practical skill in query tuning against slow queries, indexing, and execution plans, together with data loading, connectivity, version control, and clean delivery. * Practical experience developing logical data models and database schemas, and making database\-design decisions for assigned components within the established platform architecture. * The ability to own assigned database work from design through maintenance, working within data security controls, with sound judgment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.* Compensation Range: $150K \- $225K

jobs.title: Fiber‑Optic Cable Process Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Step Into a Day on the Floor** -------------------------------- You open the morning by scanning overnight production data and spotting a trend worth digging into. Coffee in hand, you head straight to the line—talking with operators, checking yields, and watching fiber stream through each station. By midday, you’re dialing in a setup for a new product trial, partnering with Maintenance on an equipment tweak, and capturing notes for an SOP update. In the afternoon, you facilitate a quick root‑cause huddle, convert findings into a Lean action plan, and hand off a training one‑pager to the shift lead. It’s hands‑on, fast, and deeply connected to how product quality, stability, and throughput come to life. **What You’ll Tackle** ---------------------- * Investigate manufacturing trends and translate insights into on‑the‑floor improvements * Keep product flowing through every stage with direct, daily shop‑floor engagement * Drive process enhancements that lift efficiency, stability, and quality * Partner with production teams to optimize equipment performance and resolve issues * Run and support new product trials and incremental process upgrades * Assist with troubleshooting, machine setups, and equipment upgrades * Analyze production data to uncover and prioritize improvement opportunities * Collaborate with Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Production to align actions * Create training materials, SOPs, and technical documentation * Advance continuous improvement using Lean, 6S, and root‑cause analysis * Own ongoing projects that require consistent follow‑through and proactive problem‑solving **About You** ------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related) * 0–3 years of manufacturing experience * Strong analytical mindset and practical problem‑solving ability * Collaborative, curious, and eager to learn * Comfortable working on the production floor and engaging across departments * Thrive in a fast‑moving manufacturing setting * Nice to have: exposure to fiber optics or wire \& cable manufacturing, ERP systems, Excel, or Minitab **Why This Role at Prysmian** ----------------------------- Work at the heart of advanced fiber‑optic cable manufacturing where your decisions directly influence output and quality. You’ll gain meaningful experience, collaborate with seasoned engineers and cross‑functional teams, and take ownership of projects that matter. If you want to accelerate your learning, build real‑world manufacturing expertise, and grow into larger responsibilities, this is your launchpad. Ready to build your engineering career with a global leader—and stay close to the process where impact is immediate? We’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- A few weeks ago a 95\-year\-old patient called one of our practices. She apologized for being long\-winded before she’d said much of anything. “I promise my mind is still very sharp,” she said; you could hear in her voice that she’d been made to feel otherwise. Our agent didn’t cut her off. It listened. She thanked it at the end of the call for being so patient. She probably didn’t know she was talking to AI. But she felt that someone had listened. Most voice agent companies in healthcare are racing to solve one thing: getting patients off hold fast enough to schedule an appointment. We think that’s the wrong finish line. The moment a patient calls is just the beginning: there’s the referral fax, the insurance check, the prescription refill, the follow\-up, the billing. Most of it is invisible to the patient and exhausting for the practice. We’re building the platform that handles all of it, with the patient at the center of every touchpoint. We’re 2 years in and working with 400\+ medical practices across 27 specialities, including primary care, dermatology, optometry, and mental health. One Medical's founder is an investor. We've raised over $13M in VC funding and grew ARR 10x last year, which means it's a great time to join. **The Role** ------------ You’d be one of the first few dedicated Agent Engineer at Parakeet. There’s no playbook for this yet… you’d be writing it. In practice: you’re in customer calls four or five times a week, translating what you hear into decisions and working prototypes (sometimes before the call even ends). You’re the person who holds context on both sides: what the customer needs, what our platform can do, and what the gap is. You make the call on what gets built now, what gets pushed, and what becomes a roadmap item. Nobody’s going to make that call for you. Healthcare scheduling is not OpenTable. A doctor might only want to see new patients in the morning and existing patients in the afternoon because that doctor runs out of steam by afternoon (and yes, that’s a real rule we’ve had to build for). Multiply that by every practice, every specialty, and every quirk that’s now yours to translate into something an AI agent can execute. If that sounds like a fascinating puzzle rather than a grind, you’re probably the right person for this role. Then there's the part that makes this more than an implementation job: the best version of this role is someone who hears something from a customer on Monday and has a working prototype to show them by Tuesday. Prototypes are the new PRDs. The gap between “I heard something interesting today” and “let me show you what I built” should be measured in hours, not sprints. Here’s a good example of how we operate: a customer told us they were drowning in 50,000 unprocessed faxes a month. The next day we had them forwarding faxes into our system. Within two weeks we had an MVP running on actual production faxes: a tool that reads incoming referrals and prior authorizations and calls the patient to schedule them. That product is live today, and what used to take 5 to 7 days now takes just one minute. The FDE is the tip of the spear on what we discover and build next. Most large healthcare practices are used to waiting 6\-9 months for something like that. We did it in 2 weeks. **A Day in Your Life** ---------------------- No two days look the same, but here’s a realistic sketch: ***Morning****:* You jump on a call with a new eyecare customer’s office manager to walk through how they handle appointment recalls. You learn they have a specific routing rule: patients who haven’t been seen in 18\+ months need to be scheduled with their original provider, but if that provider has left, they need a fallback with a different call script, and insurance needs to be checked again. You’re taking notes and already sketching how to express this in the platform before she’s even finished explaining it. ***Late morning****:* You’re configuring a deployment for a multi\-specialty medical group in NYC. Their eClinicalWorks integration needs a tweak to pull the right appointment types for their specialty scheduling flow. You push a fix, test it against their sandbox, and watch the agent nail the booking. (Small win. Onto the next one.) ***After lunch****:* Weekly sync with one of our largest enterprise accounts: a dermatology group with hundreds of locations across the country. Their VP of Operations is a fast talker with a top\-notch Hawaiian shirt game. He’s both deeply knowledgeable about their practice and genuinely excited about what’s possible with technology. Today he flags that they get 30,000 voicemails a month that nobody’s getting to. You’ve been thinking about this since hearing something similar from another customer last week. You sketch a quick prototype with Claude Code—what insights to derive, what automated actions the agent could take—and share your screen to get his reaction. The VP says: “I love it. Tell me the S3 bu n the sidelines. He’s senior enough to mentor everyone, but humble enough that nobody feels mentored. Also inexplicably West Coast for an East Coast guy. * **Mimu** joined a month ago and has already built a Claude onboarding agent that turns customer docs and meeting transcripts into a configured agent, shrinking implementation time from 5 days to 2 hours. In his spare time he’s building a 3D printed clock. (The clock was not on anyone’s roadmap.) * **Tyrone** commutes from Berkeley by bike every day, which is either impressive or unhinged depending on how you feel about the Bay Bridge. He loves climbing and will invite every new hire to go with him. * **Tom** runs Customer Success and will be your closest partner here. We took him to a client in Orlando once and they said it was the smoothest IT implementation they’d ever experienced (because: Tom). He’s technical enough to dig into a problem before passing it to engineering, funny enough to defuse a tense customer call, and somehow finds time to win Tuesday night softball championships. He also has a dachshund named Wanda who is, by any measurable metric, our most effective marketing asset. * **Jung** (co\-founder, CEO) was patient number one at One Medical: he helped the founder build the first financial model before the practice had a single location. He also built the compliance program there from scratch, which is why we're already SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant. He has a PhD in operations research, which means the person running ops here thinks like an engineer. On the weekends you can find him at the farmers market selling kimchi in honor of his mother. * **Eric** (co\-founder, CPO) was my college classmate, and we played on the same rec league basketball team before we decided to build together. He was working in ML/NLP before ChatGPT existed, which means he knew this business was possible before most people were even asking the question. Eric’s the reason we’re building in healthcare specifically… but I’ll let him tell you that story. * **Me** (Aaron, co\-founder, CTO): Eric and I have been friends since before any of this existed. I think the best thing I can say about what it’s like to work with me is that he’s still here. **Requirements** ---------------- 2\-5 years of engineering experience. Comfort working across the full stack: you don’t need to be a specialist, but you need to be able to move fast across frontend, backend, and integrations. Experience with Python is a plus. More important than any specific technology: you’ve shipped real things, you’ve talked to the people using them, and you’ve made judgment calls without waiting for someone to define the problem for you. **Interview Process** --------------------- We move quickly: you’ll hear back within 48 hours after each round. This can be as fast as two weeks end\-to\-end. * 30\-minute founder intro call * 1\-hour technical phone screen: you’ll problem\-solve through an evolving technical challenge * Full\-day onsite in San Francisco. We’ll work through real customer problems together. If your schedule allows, we’d love to make this a paid 3\-day work trial. We think it’s the best way for both sides to know if there’s a real fit. * Reference checks Offer ### **Benefits** * Excellent health, dental, and vision insurance * Free dinner * Espresso machine (pull your own shots) * Gourmet snacks and lots of Diet Cokes * Fitness stipend * Commuter benefits * Unlimited PTO * 401(k) * Relocation stipend ### **Our Office (The Nest)** In\-person, Downtown SF by Montgomery BART. After years of remote work, we wanted to be in the same room again to brainstorm, whiteboard, and actually enjoy each other’s company. There’s high ownership, no BS meetings, and a ton of gourmet snacks. Once a week we also get out of the office for a team lunch… because some of the best conversations happen away from the whiteboards. *Include a in your application for extra credit.* * Aaron, Co\-founder \& CTO Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Founding Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The job** ----------- You are our first sales engineer, and you own the technical sale. You work alongside our AEs as a partner on every deal, from the first demo through the POC to close. You lead technical discovery, run the demo, design the POC, and answer every question about how MintMCP would actually deploy in a customer's environment. The AE owns the commercial side of the deal and you own whether the buyer believes it will work, so you have as much say in how a deal gets won as anyone on it. Depending on the deal's complexity, you may stay involved after the signature: helping get customers live, doing hands\-on advanced setup (e.g., custom MCP servers, middleware), and stepping into support. You are also one of the strongest voices customers have inside MintMCP. You'll see a lot of customer environments up close, so you bring what customers need straight to product and engineering, push for it, and speak confidently to the roadmap in front of a technical buyer. We'd rather you tell us what customers actually need than tell customers what they want to hear. As our first sales engineer, you'll help shape how the function grows: the playbooks we run, how we onboard new people onto the team, and the pillars that guide it. We have strong inbound and a team of five AEs who need you on every deal. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers. **About you** ------------- * You have 4\+ years of experience, ideally as a sales engineer, solutions engineer, presales engineer, solutions architect, or forward\-deployed engineer, and you understand how a technical sale moves from first call to signature. * You have sold complex technical products (e.g., infrastructure, security, dev tools), not apps. * You come from software engineering or a logic\-based field (e.g., CS, math, physics, engineering). That said, your track record matters more than the degree. * You are hands\-on technical. You can build a custom integration, debug a deployment, and get a POC working yourself. * You communicate clearly with engineers and executives in the same meeting, and you can explain why the product matters to the business as well as how it works. * You make the reps around you more effective, and AEs want you on their deals. * You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them. * You move fast without a lot of process, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one. **Bonus** --------- * DevOps background, and you enjoy being customer\-facing. * Experience with MCP or AI agent tooling. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive base, variable, and significant equity. * Ownership of the technical sale, and a real say in how the sales engineering function grows. * A front\-row seat to agentic AI, with room for special projects like building internal agents. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

This role involves working across both front\-end and back\-end development, collaborating with designers and technical teams, integrating APIs and databases, and helping deliver reliable and scalable digital products. The ideal candidate has strong programming and problem\-solving skills and is comfortable working across different areas of the software development process. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, test, and maintain full\-stack web and application features. * Build responsive and user\-friendly front\-end interfaces. * Develop and maintain reliable back\-end services, APIs, and application logic. * Work with databases to support application functionality and data management. * Integrate third\-party APIs and external services as required. * Translate technical and business requirements into functional software solutions. * Collaborate with designers, developers, project managers, and other technical team members. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application and performance issues. * Conduct testing to help ensure application quality, reliability, and usability. * Participate in code reviews and follow established development standards. * Maintain technical documentation and development\-related records. * Assist with application deployments, updates, and ongoing maintenance. * Monitor application performance and identify opportunities for improvement. * Stay informed about relevant programming languages, frameworks, tools, and development practices. Qualifications * Previous full\-stack development, software engineering, or related experience is helpful. * Strong understanding of front\-end and back\-end web development concepts. * Experience with common programming languages, frameworks, databases, and APIs. * Familiarity with responsive design, version control, and software testing. * Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Good understanding of software development life cycles. * Strong communication and teamwork skills. * Ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical team members. * Strong attention to detail and code quality. * Ability to manage multiple development tasks and meet project deadlines. * Willingness to learn new technologies and development tools. Benefits * Professional development and technical training opportunities. * Opportunities to work on mobile applications and digital technology projects. * Supportive and collaborative work environment. * Opportunities for career growth and advancement. * Flexible scheduling may be available. * Additional benefits may vary by position and location. About the Company TekRevol Boston is a mobile app development and technology company focused on creating digital products and software solutions for businesses and organizations. Pay: $70\.45 \- $78\.16 per hour Expected hours: 42\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Vision insurance * Volunteer time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: GenAI Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Would you like to work in a position that provides exceptional benefits and a flexible working environment, using your attention to detail, strong sense of accountability, and ability to communicate with others in your career? Do you want an opportunity for strong work/life balance and career growth while working on a variety of projects with diverse groups of people companywide? If you are looking to make a difference and drive your success, you have come to the right place, and Golden Pear Funding is looking for you! Our world\-class culture is shaped by dedicated Team Members who share a drive to succeed as professionals and together as a company. A great product, amazing people and our stable financial history make Golden Pear a great place to work. We are hiring a GenAI Engineer/Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) and this is a fully remote position, and you can live anywhere in the US. Are you an engineer who loves both deep technical architecture and getting your hands dirty with real users? We are hiring a GenAI Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to build and ship production\-grade GenAI systems—and sit directly alongside the teams using them. This is a high\-autonomy hybrid role combining deep software engineering with hands\-on field work. #### **What You’ll Do** * Build for Production: Design and deploy multiagent applications using CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock, and modern cloud architectures. * Embed with Stakeholders: Work directly with business teams to translate messy, halfdefined operational workflows into functional agent designs. * Own EndtoEnd Delivery: Take broad operational challenges from initial scoping to monitored, evaluated agent teams running live in production. * Drive Measurable ROI: Iterate rapidly with short feedback loops to align agent performance with business KPIs. Who You Are: You aren't looking for a pure research or platform role—you want to see your code solve real\-world problems today. You excel at bridging technical architecture with operational needs, thrive on direct user feedback, and take pride in making AI actually land inside an organization. #### **Golden Pear Funding Offers:** * Salary range $160$210 annually DOE * Competitive PTO plus 40 hours of sick leave yearly wellness days and Holiday pay * Life, Dental, Vison, EAP, ST and LT disability * Medical for the employee and family, partial company paid * EAP * Summer Fridays * 401k match up to 4% #### **Position Summary** Under the guidance and direction of the Chief Technology, Product \& AI Officer, the GenAI Engineer / FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer) builds and ships production GenAI systems while working closely with the people who use them. The role is a hybrid of deep engineering and field work: the GenAI Engineer / FDE designs and builds agentic applications using CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock, and other platforms as appropriate, and is embedded directly with business stakeholders to understand their workflows, deploy into their environment, and iterate in alignment with defined KPIs. This is neither a research role nor a pure platform role; it requires a builder who takes ownership, works well with domain experts, and drives projects to deliver measurable results. #### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the following satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Production Agent Delivery: Design, build, and deploy multiagent GenAI applications using CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock, and modern Python tooling, moving beyond pilots and proofsofconcept into live production. * Deployed Field Work: Embed with business teams and end users to scope ambiguous problems, map existing workflows, and translate them into agent designs with clear autonomy boundaries and humanintheloop checkpoints. * AWS Architecture: Architect solutions on AWS using Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, and Aurora PostgreSQL. * RAG Systems: Build retrievalaugmented generation (RAG) systems using Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, or pgvector, including chunking, embedding, and retrieval pipeline optimization. * Evaluation \& Quality: Define and build evaluation harnesses, regression suites, and quality metrics so agent behavior can be measured and improved rather than guessed at. * Guardrails \& Security: Implement guardrails, promptinjection defenses, PII filtering, and security controls appropriate to a regulated business environment. Implement secure authentication and authorization using Amazon Cognito, IAM, Secrets Manager, and KMS, following leastprivilege and secure coding practices. * Observability \& Cost Control: Instrument agents for observability and cost control using OpenTelemetry, AWS CloudWatch, structured tracing, and token/spend monitoring dashboards. * System Integration: Integrate agents with internal systems and e gn decisions, and runbooks; mentor other team members on GenAI patterns, tool usage, and best practices. #### **Qualifications** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. #### **Education \& Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). o5\+ years of software engineering experience building production systems in Python. * 2\+ years of experience building and deploying GenAI applications, LLM pipelines, and/or multi\-agent systems. oHands\-on experience with CrewAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or similar agentic frameworks. * Proven experience with AWS AI/ML infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and AWS serverless technologies. #### **Technical Skills:** * Advanced Python proficiency (Pydantic, AsyncIO, FastAPI, pytest). oStrong expertise with AWS services (Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, Step Functions, DynamoDB, S3, OpenSearch, IAM, Cognito). * Deep understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval strategies. oHands\-on experience with evaluation tools and methodologies (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval, or custom evaluation frameworks). * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and tool\-calling patterns. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK) and CI/CD automation. #### **Soft Skills \& Field Competencies:** * Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical details to non\-technical business stakeholders. oStrong product mindset and empathy for end users; ability to translate operational pain points into practical software solutions. * High degree of autonomy, adaptability, and comfort navigating ambiguous, fast\-moving environments. Physical Demands \& Work Environment * Work Environment: 100% remote working environment. Must maintain a reliable home office setup with highspeed internet. * Physical Demands: Requires prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to communicate effectively via video conferencing, chat, and email. * Effort: The employee must be able to occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds (e.g., laptops, monitors, peripherals). Note This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. Incumbents will follow any other instructions and perform related duties as assigned by their supervisor. Golden Pear Funding is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. #### **About Golden Pear Funding OPCO LLC** Golden Pear Funding is the leading consumer litigation funding firm in the country. We are world\-class specialty finance platform deploying over $1B in capital—and we’re investing heavily in AI, data infrastructure. We work with law firms of all sizes to fund personal injury plaintiffs as quickly and efficiently as possible, offering the service, speed, and ease of use attorneys need to focus on pursuing better case outcomes and larger settlements for their clients. Why choose us: • High ownership, low bureaucracy your work actually matters • Work\-life balance that’s real sustainable pace, no burnout culture • People\-first culture you’re a contributor, not a cog. We don’t treat people like cogs in a wheel. We hire strong individuals, give them ownership, and expect them to make meaningful contributions. Come as your full self and join a diverse, talented, and fun team.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description: About Luca IQ Luca IQ is building a modern tax engine for accounting firms. Nearly every tax return prepared by a CPA in America runs through one of a small number of tax engines built decades ago. Rebuilding that infrastructure means translating tens of millions of words of tax law, regulations, and IRS guidance into software that can calculate returns correctly and consistently. We're building an API\-first tax engine designed from the ground up to calculate, validate, and file U.S. tax returns. Luca IQ is one of eight IRS\-approved tax engines for CPA firms. We’re building the infrastructure that will power the next generation of tax preparation software. About the role Professional tax preparation begins with a messy set of documents and ends with a return that must be accurate. Luca IQ is building the modern tax engine and application that makes that process faster, more reliable, and easier for tax professionals. We are looking for an AI engineer to own the intelligence layer across that workflow. You will design and maintain systems that turn documents into usable tax data, help tax professionals identify missing or inconsistent information, and review completed returns before filing. This is not a role focused on a generic chat experiences. You will build production AI systems that operate on real financial documents and work alongside a deterministic tax engine, where accuracy, traceability, and thoughtful human control matter. The Team Luca IQ was founded by Angelo Policicchio, a CPA, and Akash Sadashivapeth, who met at Harvard Business School. Our engineering team brings decades of combined experience building deterministic engines for the financial services industry, where accuracy is non\-negotiable. We’re building Luca IQ because nearly every tax return prepared by a CPA in America runs through one of a handful of tax engines built in the 1990s, and we’re building the first modern, API\-first, IRS\-approved engine to replace them. What You’ll Work On **Document collection and classification:** Build systems that collect client documents and identify what they are, including tax forms, financial statements, receipts, and supporting materials. **Extraction and normalization:** Turn structured and unstructured documents into reliable, usable data. You will design workflows to extract fields, preserve source context, resolve ambiguity, and route low\-confidence results for human\-in\-the\-loop review. **Agentic return review:** Build agents that examine a completed return alongside its source documents and relevant tax context. The system should identify missing information, inconsistencies, and potential errors, then explain findings clearly and propose corrections for a tax professional to review. **The AI experience:** Shape how tax professionals understand, trust, and act on AI output. This includes confidence, citations to source documents, review workflows, correction flows, and clear boundaries between suggestions and final decisions. **Evaluation and reliability:** Build the evaluation, observability, and feedback systems needed to measure extraction quality, agent performance, and user outcomes over time. jobs.title: Masonry Instructor (NCCER Masonry Level 1)
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The Masonry Instructor is more than an educator — this role is a mentor, industry leader, and career coach who delivers the National Center for Construction Education and Research (NCCER) Masonry Level 1 (5th Edition) curriculum to adult learners (18\+) entering the masonry trade through Skilled US's 6\-week, 224\-hour Integrated Education and Training (IET) cohort. Whatever a learner's background, the instructor meets them where they are and moves them toward an industry\-recognized credential, apprenticeship, or direct entry into the trade. This role is built on hands\-on training, where learners learn by doing in a real\-world masonry lab environment. Anchored in NCCER Masonry Level 1: Bricklaying, Block, and Mortar Craft, the instructor integrates essential\-skills instruction — safety discipline, technical proficiency, and professional habits — with embedded Adult Education and Literacy (AEL) content aligned to WIOA Title II. Beyond technical training, learners gain the employability skills — teamwork, attendance, communication, and accountability — that are essential in both life and work. **The NCCER Masonry Credential** This is an NCCER Masonry Level 1 instructional role. The instructor delivers all ten modules of NCCER Masonry Level 1 (5th Edition) and guides learners from foundational safety and tool use through residential masonry assemblies and on to employment. All completions are entered into the NCCER Registry as stackable, nationally recognized credentials. NCCER Masonry Level 1 modules taught include: Introduction to Masonry, Basic Masonry Safety (OSHA 10\), Masonry Tools and Equipment, Materials Handling, Masonry Units and Installation Techniques, Measurement and Math, Mortar, Basic Communication Skills, Residential Masonry, and Basic Employability Skills.* Holds — or completes within the first year — the NCCER Craft Instructor Certification (ICTP) in the Masonry area, and maintains lead\-instructor eligibility as required. * Applies adult\-learning principles (andragogy) to a 6\-week cohort of adult learners, many of whom are new to the construction trade, without lowering the credentialing bar. * Builds a clear pathway from Masonry Level 1 into continued NCCER craft instruction, apprenticeship, or direct employment in the masonry trade. **Key Responsibilities** **Curriculum, Instruction \& Credentialing*** Plan, prepare, and deliver all ten NCCER Masonry Level 1 (5th Edition) modules across the 6\-week, 224\-hour IET cohort, aligned with NCCER standards and WIOA Title II requirements. * Provide hands\-on instruction in masonry fundamentals — brick and block laying, mortar mixing and proportioning, tool use, scaffold assembly and safety, blueprint reading, and residential masonry assemblies (foundations, steps, patios, chimneys). * Supervise and support learners in the lab, enforcing OSHA 10 and site\-safety standards at all times. * Administer NCCER module tests and performance profiles during Week 6; track and submit certification records to the NCCER Registry to secure credential attainment. * Embed Adult Education and Literacy (AEL) activities aligned to WIOA Title II standards within each week's NCCER instruction. * Assess learner outcomes and modify instructional processes to meet stated learning objectives for the cohort. * Maintain and upgrade required NCCER instructor certification through ongoing continuing education. * Represent the YouthBuild \& Construction program and Skilled US with professionalism at all times. **Adult Learner Delivery \& Coaching*** Deliver instruction using adult\-learning principles (andragogy), adjusting pace, examples, and coaching to a cohort of adult learners entering the trade. * Provide or coordinate weekly 1:1 coaching (2 hrs/week) and monitor completion of virtual module assignments (2 hrs/week). * Reinforce embedded workforce readiness content — financial literacy, resume building, mock interviews — alongside program staff and career navigators. * Engage every learner in the learning process and work effectively with a wide range of constituencies in a diverse community. **Work\-Based Learning \& Employer Engagement*** Establish and maintain relationships with area employers, trade unions, and community organizations in the masonry and construction industry. * Oversee student job placement assistance, connecting learners with employer partners upon program completion. * Manage vendor and industry partnerships to align equipment, materials, and training with Skilled US's needs. **Program Development, Compliance \& Continuous Improvement*** Maintain accurate student records, including attendance, assessments, credential tracking, and Measurable Skill Gain (MSG) documentation in Salesforce. * Assist in developing and improving the masonry program in alignment with NCCER and industry standards. * Manage program resources, including tools, materials, and lab/shop operations. * Ensure compliance with state and federal guidelines  initiatives that expand access and outcomes for underserved communities. * Stay informed on emerging trends in the masonry trade, materials, and workforce\-development methodology. **Student \& Community Engagement*** Communicate effectively with students, employers, and program administrators. * Support learners in making informed career decisions and achieving long\-term employment success. * Facilitate mentorship, leadership development, and career coaching. * Perform additional duties as assigned by administration. **Qualifications \& Skills Required*** High school diploma or High School Equivalency, and one of the following: NCCER Masonry Craft Instructor certification (or eligibility to obtain within a defined timeframe); or a minimum of 5 years of professional masonry experience. * Hold, or be willing to complete within the first year, the NCCER Craft Instructor Certification (ICTP) in the Masonry area. * OSHA 10 certification required. * Strong understanding of masonry fundamentals, including brick and block characteristics, mortar types and mixing, scaffold safety, materials handling, blueprint reading, and residential masonry construction. * Ability to supervise and mentor adult learners in hands\-on, lab\-based learning environments. * Verifiable work experience outside of education. * Strong organizational, interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills. * Proficiency in computer applications related to instruction and student management, and willingness to participate in ongoing professional development. **Preferred*** OSHA 30 certification. * Ten (10\) years of subject\-related industry experience; teaching, training, or mentoring experience. * NCCER Master Trainer status. * Familiarity with WIOA Title II / IET program requirements and compliance\-tracking platforms (e.g., Salesforce). * Bilingual (English/Spanish/Haitian Creole). **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities*** Knowledge of course\-delivery processes, adult\-learning principles, and curriculum and training design for individuals and groups. * Knowledge of assessing learner outcomes and of the masonry trade and its application to the craft being taught. * Knowledge of relevant equipment, policies, procedures, and safety strategies to protect people, property, and data in the lab and on the worksite. * Skill to implement new strategies and procedures, and to examine and re\-engineer existing processes. * Ability to plan, organize, implement, evaluate, and modify instructional processes, and to coordinate meetings and special events. * Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with a diverse community. **Physical Effort, Working Conditions \& Schedule** **Physical Effort:** Moderate to active physical activity, including lifting, carrying, and stacking masonry materials, tools, and equipment up to 30 pounds; standing for extended periods; and keyboard manipulation. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities. **Working Conditions:** Work is performed on\-site in classroom and lab environments. This is a 100% in\-person position; essential duties must be performed in person during prescribed work hours. **Work Schedule:** Full\-time, Monday–Friday, 8:00am–4:00pm, aligned to 6\-week IET cohort cycles. Some flexibility may be required to accommodate weekly 1:1 coaching sessions. **Why This Role Is Critical** The Masonry Instructor is a life\-changing role — one that doesn't just teach a trade, it builds futures. Many learners who step into this program never considered masonry as a career. With the right instruction, mentorship, and hands\-on experience — and a portable NCCER Masonry Level 1 credential in hand — they can complete the program ready to take on the world with confidence and purpose. Whether a learner enters the workforce directly, joins an apprenticeship, or pursues further NCCER craft instruction, the Masonry Instructor ensures they are prepared, inspired, and excited for what's next. We're building autonomous proactive security from the ground up, reinforcing the tradecraft of elite security practioners into purpose\-built security models and agents that discover risk and remediate it before organizations are breached. Led by Kevin Mandia, founder of Mandiant ($5\.4B exit to Google), our team brings together researchers and engineers from Google, xAI, Meta, Stanford, Georgia Tech, Waterloo, Berkeley, and MIT to reinvent security for an adversary that never sleeps. **Role Overview** As a Senior FP\&A Analyst, you'll own financial planning and cost architecture across two critical pillars: Services costs (our go\-to\-market delivery engine) and AI/compute infrastructure (the heartbeat of our autonomous systems). This isn't a spreadsheet role. You're building cost models from scratch, working across technical and operational teams, and making sure every dollar spent maps to a strategic outcome. You'll partner directly with Expertise and Product leadership teams. You'll own the monthly cost close, build forecasts that inform hiring and feature decisions, and create feedback loops that show product teams what it actually costs to run their systems. You'll operate with radical autonomy and speed. **What You'll Do** **Own Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) \& Services Planning** * Partner with Services leadership to forecast and optimize costs; understand capacity and resource allocation, build monthly COGS close with variance analysis * Create the services cost model that informs pricing, scope, and delivery decisions * Publish monthly cost reports and KPIs; identify optimization opportunities in staffing, subcontractor costs, and delivery efficiency **Lead AI \& Compute Cost Architecture** * Design and build cloud, inference, and LLM cost model from scratch; establish baselines, identify cost drivers and build forecasts that inform product roadmap decisions * Track cloud spend, API costs, LLM token consumption, and inference infrastructure; identify anomalies and optimization levers * Create product\-facing cost transparency; explain AI cost economics to leadership, investors, and the board **Drive FP\&A Planning \& Operations** * Own monthly close, quarterly forecast, and annual budget; build rolling forecasts for hiring, pricing, and resourcing decisions * Conduct variance analysis to diagnose spend and margin drivers * Present financial reviews to leadership and board; model strategic implications (new markets, pricing, M\&A) **Build for Scale \& Automation** * Design workflows, standards, and processes that scale; write SQL queries and build spreadsheet models * Automate recurring tasks (cost pulls, variance calculations, report generation) * Evaluate and implement tools that improve planning, forecasting, and reporting capabilities **Partner with Leadership on Strategic Decisions.** * Present financial reviews to leadership and board; model strategic implications (new markets, pricing, M\&A) * Act as a business partner to Inform decisions on headcount, pricing, go\-to\-market strategy, and infrastructure scaling **What You'll Bring** * 5–7 years FP\&A or finance ideally in SaaS; understand subscription economics, unit economics, and P\&L impact at scale * Startup operator mentality: self\-directed, comfortable with ambiguity, owns outcomes independently * Advanced Excel (formulas, macros), SQL, and light scripting; can pull data, build models, and automate reporting * AI/LLM cost modeling experience or ability to learn quickly (cloud infrastructure, inference, token APIs valuable) * Clear communicator: explains complex financial concepts to engineers, product leaders, and executives **Even Better With** * Direct experience with AI/LLM cost models or compute\-intensive infrastructure (cloud, inference, data pipelines) * High\-growth SaaS, security, or infrastructure startup background with significant venture funding * Experience building or scaling an FP\&A function; partnering with product/engineering on financial trade\-offs and pricing * Proficiency with financial modeling tools * Familiarity with Harvest or similar time\-tracking software * History of working high\-autonomy, high\-stakes environments **Location** In\-office in Palo Alto, CA **Benefits \& Perks \| FTE** Full Health, Dental, \& Vision Coverage Meaningful Equity Ownership In\-Office Meals Haircuts at the Office Company Sponsored Conferences \& Events 401(k), HSA, and FSA Plans Flexible PTO

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** =============== Rational Dynamics builds customized AI reasoning systems for tasks of high cognitive complexity. Our initial market is the world’s leading institutional asset owners. We work very closely with these customers to create specialized, rigorous benchmark datasets encompassing their most valuable and difficult knowledge work. Then we use the benchmarks to construct agentic large reasoning models, applying the same rigor to prove that the models correctly do the work. Customers access the models through a tailored application service, making their most skilled, expensive workers dramatically more productive. We are an early\-stage startup. Our founders previously started Voleon, now one of the world’s largest systematic investment managers, and recognized as a longstanding industry leader in applied machine learning. They bring to Rational Dynamics the same research discipline and data\-driven focus that succeeded in the unforgiving, high\-stakes setting of financial markets. **About the role** ================== Institutional investors want AI for their hardest analytical work, running inside their cloud accounts and regions, under their security and compliance rules. Rational Dynamics builds that AI. Infrastructure decides whether we can ship it: each client brings a different cloud, network, identity provider, and security review. You'll be working across client deployments, internal platform, and the research infrastructure, collaborating with product development and science teams. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Deploy our cloud\-native platform into client clouds on AWS, GCP, and Azure, including multi\-region and data\-residency setups. Answer the security and architecture questions client IT teams raise * Co\-own existing infrastructure in AWS and GCP: EKS, Aurora Postgres, Cloud Run, networking, IAM, secrets, and GitOps delivery * Run the research platform for evals and training: proprietary, open\-source, managed services such as Vertex AI, SageMaker, and Bedrock, with GPU compute and storage infrastructure * Build CI/CD, observability, and alerting that let a small team ship daily and catch problems before clients do * Stand up rapid prototypes and harden existing prototypes for production. Give Forward Deployed Engineers tooling to do the same in client environments * Share compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, CAIQ) and security work so audit evidence comes from how the platform runs * Contribute to platform development, MLOps, and internal GenAI tools * Manage infrastructure as code in Terraform, write down the trade\-offs behind each decision, and track reliability, uptime, and cost **What you bring** ------------------ * 7\+ years designing and running production cloud infrastructure, 5\+ of them at Senior level or above * Depth in AWS or GCP, and hands\-on experience with both * Strong Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD, including GitOps with ArgoCD or similar * Cloud networking and security: VPCs, private connectivity, IAM, zero\-trust access, encryption, secrets, and multi\-region deployments with data\-residency requirements * Deployments into enterprise customer clouds in finance, healthcare, defense, or another regulated industry * Work under SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or a similar control framework * Core infrastructure built from scratch at an early\-stage company, or owned end to end on a small team * Python and Bash for automation, and daily use of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code * Clear communication about designs and trade\-offs with engineers, scientists, and client security teams, and comfort with shifting priorities **Nice to have** ---------------- * Azure (AKS, VNets, Entra ID, ML/AI) or Oracle Cloud (OCI) * ML and GPU infrastructure: Kubeflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker, Bedrock, MLflow, Ray, KServe, Slurm * Infrastructure for LLM and agent systems: model serving, vector databases, and training and eval pipelines * Workflow tools such as Temporal, Airflow, Argo Workflows, Tekton * Full\-stack or agentic application development, or ML and RL research * Go or another systems language * A record of running production systems against reliability and uptime targets **“Friends of Rational Dynamics” Candidate Referral
