jobs.title: Senior Staff Linux Security Engineer
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** The Crusoe Cloud Software Development team is seeking a passionate and experienced Senior Staff Software Engineer specializing in Linux Kernel Security. This critical role is essential in strengthening the security posture of our core Linux kernel and operating system components, which underpin our cutting\-edge hardware and software solutions for the AI cloud. A deep understanding of Linux kernel internals, security vulnerabilities, mitigation techniques, and secure development practices is paramount for developing reliable, high\-assurance systems. This is a full\-time position. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Kernel Hardening \& CVE Triage**: Implement kernel security enhancements, manage configuration hardening, and triage incoming CVEs to assess severity and exploitability. * **Access Control, Boot Security \& Guardrails: Enforce mandatory access controls, secure the boot path, and establish CI guardrails and fuzzing coverage to prevent regressions.** * **Vulnerability Research \& Analysis**: Research vulnerabilities across kernel, driver, and OS components to build proactive mitigations and backport non\-trivial upstream fixes to production. * **Secure Development Practices**: Establish and advocate for secure coding standards and best practices for kernel\-level development. Conduct security\-focused code reviews to identify and eliminate potential vulnerabilities early in the development lifecycle. * **Security Auditing \& Tools**: Utilize and develop specialized tools for kernel security auditing, fuzzing, static analysis, and dynamic analysis to uncover hidden vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security policies. * **Incident Response Support**: Provide expert support during security incidents involving kernel or OS\-level compromises, assisting with root\-cause analysis, containment, and recovery efforts. * **Performance and Security Balance**: Work to ensure that security enhancements do not unduly impact system performance, especially critical for our high\-performance AI infrastructure. * **First 90 days: Own kernel CVE triage end to end and have shipped at least one backported fix through our full release path. You have an independent read on where our kernel configuration is weakest.** * **First year: Kernel security response has a defined SLA by severity and we consistently hit it. A hardening baseline is defined, enforced in CI, and rolled out across supported SKUs. Cloud Hypervisor has been audited and the highest\-value isolation gaps are closed or scheduled.** * **Cloud Hypervisor \& Isolation**: Audit, harden, and reduce privilege across Cloud Hypervisor device models and vhost\-user datapaths, contributing upstream security fixes and advancing confidential computing primitives (AMD SEV\-SNP, Intel TDX). * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**: Collaborate closely with other engineering teams (hardware, hypervisor, OS development, cloud infrastructure, and security operations) to integrate security best practices and ensure a comprehensive security strategy across the stack. * **Technical Leadership**: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers on kernel security best practices, fostering a culture of security awareness and excellence. * **Debugging and Root\-Cause Analysis**: Debug and root\-cause a variety of complex security\-related issues at the kernel level. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Linux Kernel Security Expertise**: Proven deep knowledge of Linux kernel internals (e.g., memory management, process scheduling, system calls, I/O subsystems) with a strong focus on security aspects. * **Vulnerability \& Exploitation Knowledge**: Solid understanding of common kernel vulnerabilities (e.g., privilege escalation, information disclosure, denial of service) and associated exploitation techniques. * **Security Mitigations**: Experience with existing Linux kernel security mitigations (e.g., ASLR, DEP/NX, SMEP/SMAP, KASLR, namespaces, cgroups, LSMs like SELinux/AppArmor). * **Secure Coding**: Strong background in secure coding principles and experience conducting security\-focused code reviews, particularly in C. * **Debugging \& Analysis Tools**: Proficiency with kernel debugging tools (e.g., GDB, crash, kgdb) and security analysis tools (e.g., valgrind, address sanitizers, fuzzers). * **Hardware Security Concepts**: Familiarity with hardware\-assisted security features (e.g., Intel SGX, AMD SEV, ARM TrustZone) and their relevance to kernel security. * **Education \& Experience**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, and a minimum of 5 years of relevant industry experience with at least 3 years focused on low\-level operating systems or kernel security. * **Safety and Compliance**: Must be able to pass a background check. * **Company Values**: Embody the Company values. * Experience dealing with CVE Remediation and automation * First 90 days: **You own kernel CVE triage** end to end and have shipped at least one backported fix through our full release path. You have an independent read on where our kernel configuration is weakest. * First year: **Kernel security response has a defined SLA** by severity and we consistently hit it.A hardening baseline is defined, enforced in CI, and rolled out across supported SKUs. Cloud Hypervisor has been audited and the highest\-value isolation gaps are closed or scheduled. **Bonus Points** * Experience with specific kernel security projects or contributions to open\-source kernel security initiatives. * Familiarity with hypervisor security and the interaction between the hypervisor and the guest kernel's security. * Experience with hardware security modules (HSMs) or Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs). * Background in offensive security or penetration testing at the kernel level. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $250,000 \- $300,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.description: **Position Description:** Reporting to the Director of Manufacturing and Operations, this role is responsible for the design and development of both new and existing medical device manufacturing equipment and fixtures. **Job Responsibilities:** * Lead initiatives to improve manufacturing processes, optimize product performance, and reduce production costs while maintaining quality and regulatory compliance. * Provide hands\-on manufacturing support and coordinate the implementation of process improvements for assigned product lines. protocols and reports, including Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), Performance Qualification (PQ), Gage R\&R studies, and Test Method Validations (TMV). * Conduct Effects Analysis (DFMEA), Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), risk assessments, Critical\-to\-Quality (CTQ) requirements, and design transfer activities to establish and maintain robust manufacturing processes. * Manage and support corrective and preventive maintenance activities, equipment calibration programs, and related compliance requirements. * Design, develop, assemble, and qualify manufacturing equipment, fixtures, and tooling to support production objectives. * Create and maintain comprehensive equipment documentation, including operating procedures, work instructions, validation records, and technical specifications. * Operate within a highly regulated environment and ensure compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and applicable regulatory requirements. * Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams including Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R\&D, Supply Chain, and external suppliers to achieve project and business objectives. * Support technology transfers, new product introductions, and process validation activities from development through commercial production. * Travel up to 10% domestically to support manufacturing sites, suppliers, validation activities, and continuous improvement initiatives. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent education/experience * 5 industrial PLCs and related software. * Experience with dip molding manufacturing processes. * Experience with model shop planning and prototype development. * Experience supporting process improvements, equipment validation, and manufacturing efficiency initiatives. jobs.title: Data Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **About Camlin** Camlin is a global technology leader that operates with the vision of bringing revolutionary products to life for a wide range of industries, including power and rail, and also has interests in a number of R\&D projects in a variety of scientific sectors. At Camlin we believe in high quality engineering and design, allowing us to develop market leading products and services. In short, we love creating value for our customers by solving difficult problems. As of now, Camlin operates in over 20 countries worldwide.**Overview** ============ Under the direction of the Asset Performance Director, the Asset Analytics Engineer, will provide expert condition assessment and asset health evaluation by analyzing maintenance and monitoring data from customer HV assets: transformers, circuit breakers, and rotating machines. They will support the design and validation of analytics and algorithms developed for Camlin’s Sapient Software platforms and apply similar algorithms to be used for front end support for the Camlin Sapient Centre. **Key Responsibilities:** ========================= * Support the development of models and algorithms for the automated assessment of failure modes and prescriptive maintenance to assure asset health. * Interface with internal teams involved with Camlin software development, acting as liaison between Asset Performance to Data Science and development teams. * Test and validate models against old and new data collected from Condition Assessment reporting within the Asset Performance Team. * Review and analyze customer data and prepare reports for periodic review of customer online monitoring information. * Prepare Condition Assessment Reports for customer assets utilizing customer online monitoring and maintenance test data. * Manage and maintain consolidated customer datasets and leverage these datasets for analysis and customer reporting of fleet trends, risk reporting, and anomaly detections. * Prepare templates, Spreadsheets and scripts to automate the analysis of customer data for periodic data review and condition assessment reporting. * Research industry advancements in AI/ML applications and explore how Camlin’s data may be leveraged to develop similar models to enhance features in Sapient Asset Insights. * Author technical papers and articles on AI/ML applications and data/analytics for Power Systems Assets. * Focus on development as an industry expert in asset data and analytics; AI/ML applications to Power System Assets. **Qualifications** ================== * Graduate in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering from a University or College of recognized standing. * Relevant work experience in technical roles within the Energy industry will also be considered. * Must be proficient in reading and interpretation of industry standards and guides. * Must be proficient in English; both verbal and written. * Strong communication and presentation skills. **Our Values*** We work together * We believe in people * We won’t accept the ‘way it has always been done’ * We listen to learn * We’re trying to do the right thing **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** Individuals seeking employment at Camlin are considered without regards to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital states, ancestry, physical or mental disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Advanced NDT Engineer IV
jobs.description: Carpenter Technology Corporation is a leading producer and distributor of premium specialty alloys, including titanium alloys, nickel and cobalt based superalloys, stainless steels, alloy steels and tool steels. Carpenter's high\-performance materials and advanced process solutions are an integral part of critical applications used within the aerospace, transportation, medical and energy markets, among other markets. Building on its history of innovation, Carpenter's wrought and powder technology capabilities support a range of next\-generation products and manufacturing techniques, including novel magnetic materials and additive manufacturing. **Principal Purpose of Position:** A technically curious engineer who enjoys experimentation, data analysis, and solving difficult detection challenges. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable working in a laboratory, around production inspection systems, and behind a computer analyzing large volumes of ultrasonic data. Someone who is motivated by pushing the limits of defect detection and redefining what is possible in ultrasonic inspection technology. **Research \& Technology Development** * Design, execute, and analyze experimental programs focused on improving immersion ultrasonic inspection sensitivity. * Develop and validate novel ultrasonic testing methodologies capable of detecting increasingly smaller defects and inclusions. * Investigate advanced technologies including focused immersion probes, phased array ultrasonic testing (PAUT), FMC/TFM imaging, multi\-probe systems, and differential signal processing techniques. * Evaluate emerging NDT technologies and benchmark performance against industry best practices. * Plan and conduct laboratory and production\-scale experiments using immersion ultrasonic systems. * Analyze ultrasonic signals using advanced statistical, mathematical, and digital signal processing techniques. * Develop algorithms and data analysis methods to improve signal\-to\-noise ratio and defect characterization. * Utilize software tools such as Python, MATLAB, Minitab, or equivalent platforms for data analysis and modeling. * Establish detection thresholds and quantify capability for critical defect sizes. * Work with equipment suppliers and internal stakeholders to evaluate new probes, transducers, instrumentation, and scanning systems. * Design test methods, calibration standards, and validation procedures for new inspection technologies. * Support installation, integration, and optimization of experimental and production ultrasonic equipment. * Recommend future technology investments and equipment roadmaps. * Collaborate with Quality, Manufacturing, Metallurgy, Product Development, and Process Engineering teams. * Provide subject matter expertise in ultrasonic testing and NDT technologies. * Develop technical reports, presentations, specifications, and standard operating procedures. * Support intellectual property generation through invention disclosures, patents, and technical publications. * Candidate must obtain Carpenter UT Level 3 certification within 2 years of start date. **Qualification \& Commercialization** * Validate inspection methodologies for aerospace, automotive, medical, energy, and other critical applications. * Develop technical specifications and acceptance criteria for next\-generation inspection processes. * Support transfer of successful technologies from R\&D into production environments. **Education and/or Training:** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, NDT Engineering, or related discipline. * Minimum 5 years of experience in Metallurgy, ultrasonic testing, NDT, signal processing, materials characterization, or experimental engineering. * Experience designing and executing technical experiments. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Experience with statistical analysis and data interpretation. * Knowledge of ultrasonic wave propagation, flaw detection, and inspection system calibration. * Proficiency with data analysis tools such as Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or equivalent. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's or Ph.D. in a relevant engineering or scientific discipline. * ASNT Level II or Level III certification in Ultrasonic Testing. * Experience with immersion ultrasonic testing systems. * Experience with phased array ultrasonic testing (PAUT), FMC, or Total Focusing Method (TFM). * Knowledge of signal processing, machine learning, or AI applications in NDT. * Experience inspecting bars, billets, forgings, aerospace alloys, or specialty metals. * Familiarity with ASTM, AMS, Nadcap, aerospace, or medical material inspection requirements. * Patent, publication, or technology commercialization experience. Carpenter Technology Company offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package including life, medical, dental, vision, flexible spending accounts, disability coverage, 401k with company contributions as well as many other options to employees. jobs.title: Software Engineer 1
jobs.description: **About Centric Software:** Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI\-enabled product\-concept\-to\-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best\-of\-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever\-changing market. Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional. **About the Role** Centric Software is seeking a motivated **Software Engineer I** to join our product development organization. This is an entry\-level software engineering position for candidates who have a strong foundation in computer science and software development and are eager to grow their skills while contributing to production software used by customers around the world. As a Software Engineer I, you will work as part of an agile development team alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and quality engineers. You will contribute to product features, resolve defects, improve existing functionality, and develop the technical and professional skills needed to become an increasingly independent software engineer. You will receive structured onboarding, mentorship, and hands\-on experience with Centric Software's development practices, tools, architecture, and products. **Responsibilities** **Software Development** * Design, implement, test, and maintain software features under the guidance of experienced engineers. * Work on user stories, product enhancements, technical tasks, and defect resolution as part of an agile development team. * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code that follows established engineering standards and best practices. * Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to continuously improve code quality and technical skills. * Investigate software defects, identify root causes, and implement appropriate fixes. Develop an understanding of the existing application architecture and make changes that integrate effectively with the broader product. * **Technical Areas** Depending on team needs, product area, and individual strengths, you may contribute in one or more of the following areas: * **Full\-Stack Development:** Develop product functionality across front\-end and back\-end components using technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Java, and related frameworks. * **Front\-End Development:** Build responsive, maintainable user interfaces and reusable components while delivering a high\-quality user experience. * **Back\-End Development:** Develop server\-side services, business logic, APIs, and application components with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance. * **Database Development:** Work with relational and NoSQL databases, including data modeling, queries, performance optimization, and integration with application features. * **AI and Emerging Technologies:** Contribute to selected projects involving Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, machine learning, or AI\-enabled product capabilities. **Engineering Practices** * Participate in the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements clarification, design, implementation, testing, code review, deployment, and defect resolution. * Use source control, continuous integration, automated testing, and issue\-tracking tools as part of the team's development workflow. * Create unit and automated tests to verify software behavior and reduce regressions. * Learn and apply secure, scalable, and maintainable software engineering practices. * Use modern development tools, including AI\-assisted development tools where appropriate, to improve productivity while maintaining engineering quality and accountability. **Collaboration and Growth** * Collaborate effectively with engineers, QA, product managers, and other members of the product organization. * Ask questions, seek feedback, and communicate technical issues, progress, and risks clearly. * Take increasing ownership of assigned work as technical knowledge and experience grow. * Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, sprint planning, retrospectives, and other team activities. * Share knowledge and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture. * Work with an assigned mentor and engineering manager to establish development goals and build technical depth. Develop toward independently delivering well\-defined product features and resolving increasingly complex technical problems. * **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Foundational knowledge of software development concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented programming, and software design. * Programming experience through coursework, internships, personal projects, research, or professional experience. * Experience with at least one modern programming language such as Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C\+\+, or a similar language. * Understanding of fundamental web application concepts, APIs, databases, and client/server architecture. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies and work within an existing, large\-scale software codebase. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively within a software development team. * **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with one or more of the following is beneficial but not required: * Java and Java\-based server\-side development * JavaScript and TypeScript * React, Angular, Node.js, or similar web technologies * HTML and CSS * SQL and relational databases * NoSQL databases * REST APIs and distributed applications * Git and Bitbucket * Jira and other Agile development tools * Jenkins or other continuous integration/continuous delivery tools * Unit testing frameworks such as JUnit * Cloud technologies and containerized applications * Natural Language Processing, machine learning, or Large Language Models AI\-assisted software development tools * **What Success Looks Like** During your first year as a Software Engineer I, you will progressively: * Become proficient with Centric Software's development environment, tools, processes, and product architecture. * Successfully complete well\-defined engineering tasks and product stories with appropriate guidance. * Develop the ability to investigate and resolve software defects independently. * Consistently write maintainable code supported by appropriate testing. * Incorporate code\-review feedback and demonstrate continued improvement in engineering quality. * Communicate effectively with your team regarding requirements, technical decisions, progress, and risks. * Take increasing ownership of features from implementation through validation and delivery. * Build the technical foundation required to progress toward a Software Engineer II role. **Work Environment** This position operates in a collaborative development environment. Depending on the team and product area, employees may work in a remote or hybrid arrangement that includes regular collaboration from Centric Software's **Campbell, California office** . Specific in\-office expectations will be communicated based on team requirements. *Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.*

jobs.description: **Discover your future at Citi** -------------------------------- Working at Citi is far more than just a job. In this critical leadership role, you will define and execute the target\-state architectural vision for Citi’s cross\-asset **X\-Value Adjustment (XVA)** valuation, risk, and stress testing platforms (encompassing CVA, DVA, FVA, MVA, and KVA). You will spearhead the modernization of mission\-critical pricing and risk calculation pipelines using high\-performance distributed systems, modern cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/OpenShift), microservices, and cutting\-edge **AI/LLM\-enabled software engineering**. You will pioneer the integration of **Agentic AI workflows, Multi\-Agent systems, and MLOps**, transforming developer productivity across the SDLC and accelerating legacy system modernization into next\-generation real\-time valuation frameworks. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Strategic Architecture \& Technical Leadership** and semi\-autonomous Agentic AI systems to optimize complex pricing workflows, trade lifecycle reconciliations, and stress testing scenario generation. * **AI\-Assisted SDLC \& Developer Productivity:** Drive enterprise\-grade AI enablement across engineering pods—integrating LLM\-driven coding assistants, automated test generation, semantic code search, and architecture review agents to double engineering velocity. * **Legacy Modernization with AI:** Leverage Generative AI and code\-reasoning models to reverse\-engineer, refactor, and migrate monolithic legacy calculation engines onto modular target\-state microservices. * **MLOps \& Model Governance:** Implement end\-to\-end MLOps pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, MLflow) for model tracking, validation, deployment, fairness, interpretability, and strict adherence to internal model governance and ethical AI policies. **Program Execution \& Quantitative Collaboration** --------------------------------------------------- * **XVA Strategy \& Stress Testing Migration:** Lead the delivery of cross\-asset XVA technology programs, managing the end\-to\-end migration of CVA/XVA stress testing engines to the target valuation framework. * **Quant \& Desk Partnership:** Act as the primary technical partner to Quantitative Analysts (Quants), Financial Engineers, Trading Desks, and Risk Officers, translating mathematical models (SIMM, VaR, Greeks, Monte Carlo simulations) into scalable, production\-grade enterprise software. * **Agile Program Governance:** Lead teams. **Risk, Controls \& Regulatory Governance** ------------------------------------------- * **Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure all technology solutions comply with Basel III/IV, FRTB, Dodd\-Frank, The team manages the core platforms, integrations, and infrastructure that enable DHR to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable digital services supporting the City’s 35,000\+ employees and hundreds of thousands of job applicants annually. Supporting internal and Citywide departments and programs, the Systems and Analytics Team ensures that HR platforms, workflows, and analytics function effectively at scale — supporting everything from employee service delivery and HR case management to workflow automation, data modeling and reporting, and platform integrations. The team plays a critical role in modernizing HR operations across the HR landscape Citywide. Becoming a City employee means being a part of a team that cares about making a difference. Your work will shape both the present and future of San Francisco. When you work for the City, you’re choosing a job with purpose. **Job Description** The City and County of San Francisco is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead development work building DHR's data infrastructure and hiring systems. Under the leadership of the Head of People Technology, this role supervises engineers developing data pipelines, integrations, and cloud applications that implement and automate HR processes. The Engineering Manager works closely with product development staff, subject matter experts, and software engineers to ensure our applications are efficient, secure, and meet the needs of users across the City. jobs.title: AI/ML Software Engineer
jobs.description: **AI/ML Software Engineer** --------------------------- ### **Role Overview** We are seeking a talented and driven **AI/ML Software Engineer** to bridge the gap between advanced machine learning research and high\-performance software production systems. In this role, you will design, build, test, and deploy scalable AI\-driven features and robust machine learning architectures, working closely with product managers, data scientists, and backend engineering teams. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Model Integration \& Development: Design, fine\-tune, and evaluate machine learning models, integrating them seamlessly into production applications via robust APIs. * Data Pipeline Engineering: Build, optimize, and maintain efficient data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and continuous model training. * Production Deployment \& MLOps: Containerize and deploy models using modern cloud infrastructure, ensuring low latency, high scalability, and uptime. * Monitoring \& Performance Tuning: Track deployed models for performance drift, resource consumption, accuracy gaps, and inference cost efficiency. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering stakeholders to scope AI use cases, translate business requirements into technical specs, and define success metrics. * Quality \& Evaluation: Establish automated test suites and rigorous evaluation frameworks to measure model accuracy, robustness, and safety. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related technical field. * Experience: 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands\-on work building, shipping, and supporting machine learning models in production environments. * Programming Proficiency: Strong software engineering fundamentals with expert\-level proficiency in Python (including standard scientific computing libraries like NumPy and Pandas). * ML Ecosystem: Working knowledge of major machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit\-Learn. * Software Core Concepts: Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, system design, RESTful APIs, and Git version control workflows. * Data Management: Practical experience with SQL and relational or non\-relational database management. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced Degree: Master’s or Ph.D. degree specializing in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), or Computer Vision. * Cloud Platforms: Hands\-on experience deploying and managing workloads on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Generative AI \& LLMs: Experience working with Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, vector databases, and modern AI application frameworks. * Infrastructure \& Automation: Proven familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipeline automation, and container orchestration. * Observability: Exposure to model monitoring and evaluation tooling (e.g., MLflow, LangSmith, or Prometheus) to track production health and trace model outputs.

The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I\&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future. Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start\-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented individual with an innovative mindset to join the Converge for FSI team in our mission to develop differentiated financial services products that achieve product\-market fit. This role is focused on Fund \& Investment Operations, an integrated, AI\-enabled platform delivering oversight of fund and investment operation, transparency into service provider performance and production engine for regulatory reporting, data management and compliance. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte's innovation \& product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities. **Position Summary** We are looking for a highly skilled and client\-facing Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer partnership. In this role, you will embed directly with our most strategic clients \- particularly in the financial services sector \- to understand their toughest technical challenges and help them design and implement world\-class solutions using our platform. This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role with direct influence on product direction. You will bring the client's data products to life and solve real problems that only surface when a platform meets production data. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding microservices architecture with a client's principal engineer, running a hands\-on technical workshop for a team of developers, and standing up a compelling proof\-of\-concept in days. You thrive in fast\-moving, high\-stakes environments and know how to earn the trust of deeply technical stakeholders. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026\. **Work you'll do** * Serve as the primary technical point of contact for strategic client accounts, building deep relationships with architects, engineers, and technical leaders * Lead discovery sessions to understand client architectures, pain points, and business objectives * Translate complex functional concepts into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non\-technical audiences * Look at trends in the market and experiment, bringing new ideas into the Product roadmap * Collaborate with client architects and implementation teams to configure and publish data products * Work hands\-on with implementation teams to define data product structure including schema, ownership, SLAs, quality expectations, and governance attributes * Independently structure and clean large\-scale financial data and load into the tool's models * Enable implementation teams to self\-serve data product creation over time and increase the configurability in the process * Run office hours, enablement sessions, and targeted training to help teams build confidence independently * Review and advise on client system designs, identifying risks and recommending best practices * Experience coordinating across time zones and operating on a onshore, near shore, offshore model * Produce high\-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides * Accelerate client time\-to\-value by enabling their teams to build confidently and independently * Act as the voice of the customer \- surface product gaps, integration friction, and feature requests to internal product and engineering teams The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, bonus Java Springboot, ReactJS * Understanding of data product concepts including schema design, data ownership, SLAs, quality frameworks, and governance * Experience building LLM\-powered agentic systems that use tools, execute multi\-turn workflows, manage state, and recover from errors, with a strong understanding of token economics and how to optimize cost and latency across model calls. * Hands\-on experience with microservices design principles: service decomposition, API design, resiliency patterns, observability * Experience working with structured data and unstructured data * Experience with data governance, data cataloguing, metadata management platforms, and data quality validation frameworks * Proficiency across multi\-cloud environments, with AWS as a primary platform; working knowledge of Azure and GCP. Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client\-relevant use cases * Exceptional communicator \- able to lead technical conversations with senior engineers and C\-suite stakeholders alike * Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions * Self\-directed, pro\-active, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client implementations simultaneously * Natural curiosity and a bias for building \- you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent field. * 6\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent in client\-facing, solutions engineering, or field engineering roles specifically in the Investment Management industry * Ability to travel 20\-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Familiarity with concepts like AUM, NAV, positions/transactions, Reg Reporting or portfolio accounting is a strong plus, though not required to start. * Familiarity with financial data platforms * Experience with **AWS\-based data infrastructure** (EMR, S3, Glue) or **Snowflake** * Experience working in a start\-up or product company with a strong sense of building reusable but configurable Products. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400\-$207,800\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

You will drive commercial success by defining commercialization models, working with internal teams to enable licensing, and making it easier for Market Makers to sell products to clients. You will be part of the General Manager's leadership team, responsible for proactively bringing ideas that push the business forward, weighing in on key decisions, and helping junior resources across the team overcome hurdles. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026\. **Work you'll do** As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer, you will split your time between winning new product business and delivering on it once sold. You will: **Pre\-Sale:** * Build and maintain relationships with market makers, buyer decision\-makers, and Deloitte account teams to identify and shape product opportunities * Prepare and deliver pitches and product demos to client executives (including C\-suite), translating Signals for FSI product value into a clear business case * Develop go\-to\-market materials \- pitch decks, demo scripts, one\-pagers, case studies \- that Sales and Product teams can reuse across engagements * Partner with Market Makers and Product Managers to scope, price, and staff delivery engagements (incl. building scoping documents, pricing models, and commercial agreements) * Enable commercialization of products, create standardized license agreements, and be an advisor to Market Makers less familiar with taking Products to market **Post\-Sale:** * Lead delivery of scoped proofs of concept (POCs) and in\-market testing, working hands\-in\-hand with engineering and data science teams to deliver the product to the client to drive outcomes for their business * Serve as the client's primary point of contact post\-sale, managing scope, timeline, and outcomes, and escalating/resolving issues that put delivery at risk * Translate client requirements and product gaps back to Product Managers to inform the product feature backlog, distinguishing custom delivery needs from core product enhancements * Build, maintain, and scale reusable delivery assets, demo patterns, and implementation playbooks that accelerate the sales and deployment cycle for future engagements * Provide a continuous feedback loop between clients and the product team, and support knowledge transfer to delivery teams * Operate within defined engagement guardrails \- scoped, time\-boxed, and outcome\-oriented \- to protect capacity and ensure clean handoffs at the end of each deployment/delivery The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Comfortable moving fluidly between client\-facing selling conversations and hands\-on delivery oversight, without needing to write the underlying code * Strong executive presence and communicator, able to translate technical product capability into a business case for client executives and internal stakeholders alike * Able to work effectively alongside engineering and technical delivery teams \- understanding enough of the tech cope, sequence, and troubleshoot delivery without being the hands\-on engineer or data scientist * Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry sufficient to speak credibly to industry\-specific client problems across banking, insurance, and investment management * Ability to deliver work within scope / timelines and take an "outcomes" mindset to ensure client receives maximum value * Comfortable working through hard, ambiguous problems that require critical thinking, resourcefulness, and grit * Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client\-relevant use cases * Deep understanding of customer data science, segmentation, and behavioral insights that can be leveraged for sales and marketing across consumer and business customers * Knowledge and experience across the marketing, sales and distribution of financial services products and services * Deep understanding of customer data platforms, use of market research survey data and data science modeling to project insights and findings to larger populations * Understanding of data transfer protocols \- SFTP, Cloud Bucket to Bucket transfers, Clean Rooms and CRMs, and Martech Customer Data Platforms * Awareness and depth of knowledge of 1 st and 3 rd party data uses to drive marketing and sales. * Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions * Self\-directed, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously * Natural curiosity and a bias for building \- you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Data Science or equivalent field. MBA a plus. * 3\+ years of client\-facing management or technology consulting / professional services experience, including leading delivery of technology\-enabled engagements * 2\+ years of experience within, or delivering consulting/technology engagements to, the financial services industry * Demonstrated experience working alongside engineering, data science, or technical delivery teams to scope, sequence, and troubleshoot data / technology implementations, without requiring hands\-on coding * Demonstrated experience contributing to sales and business development activities (e.g., client pitches, proposals, demos) in addition to delivery * Ability to travel 20\-40%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Experience selling and/or delivering licensable software/data products or productized services, as distinct from custom SOW\-based or traditional consulting delivery * Prior experience in a startup, high\-growth SaaS or data/insights environment * Prior experience using AI and LLMs to rapid prototype in a sales, business development or product demonstrations The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400\-$207,800\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Demand The Limits is looking for a full\-stack software engineer who cares how software works and how it feels to use. You will help a small team build websites, internal tools, and new product features. Our priorities move quickly, so we need someone who can understand a problem, propose a clear design, and turn it into working software. The skill we most want to add is an eye for design. You should be comfortable talking with users, shaping workflows, and making sound UI/UX decisions without waiting for a finished mockup. You will work within our design system and collaborate with marketing, staff, and other engineers. Current work includes internal tools and marketing experiences built with Next.js, but the projects will change as the firm grows. **The impact of this role** The tools you build will support staff whose work directly affects clients' lives. A clearer internal workflow can give the team more time for clients; a better marketing experience can make it easier for someone to reach us. You will work with the people who use these tools, see the difference your changes make, and improve them as needs change. **What you will do** * Design and build usable, responsive interfaces for public and internal applications. * Work across the stack, including frontend code, APIs, forms, and integrations. * Learn from users, prototype practical workflows, build and release them, then improve them with feedback. **Apply our design system with attention to accessibility, performance, and clear writing.** * Use AI coding tools responsibly, reviewing their output and testing the software you ship. * Help plan, release, and support your work with the rest of the engineering team. **What you bring** * 1 to 3 years of software development experience, including shipped full\-stack web applications and work with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. * Good UI/UX judgment, including layout, typography, and interaction design, with examples of interfaces you designed or substantially improved yourself. * Familiarity with the latest AI tooling is highly encouraged, especially for designing, building, and testing software. * Comfort working with APIs, data, and third\-party integrations. * The ability to make progress when requirements are still taking shape, explain tradeoffs, and work well with nontechnical colleagues. * Sound engineering habits around testing, code review, security, and maintainability. We value well\-rounded engineers who can move comfortably between design, application code, integrations, and deployment. Strong product and design judgment matter most. We care about what you have built, how you think, and the judgment you bring to a small team. Be ready to discuss an interface you helped shape and ship, including your own design and engineering decisions.We are seeking a dynamic and highly skilled Full Stack Software Engineer to join our innovative development team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications and systems that power our core services. You will work across the full technology stack, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software solutions that meet business needs. Your expertise in both front\-end and back\-end development, combined with a strong understanding of system architecture and cloud infrastructure, will drive the success of our projects and enhance user experiences worldwide. Join us as a Full Stack Software Engineer to innovate at the intersection of technology and user experience! Your expertise will help shape scalable systems that empower users while advancing your career in a vibrant tech environment dedicated to continuous growth and excellence. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Temporary Worker
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **\*\*TEMP Role – W2 on Dentsu Payroll Only** **\*\*ASAP – 12/31/2026** **\*\*Approximately 40 Hours/Week** **\*\*Progressive Project Management Experience at a Digital Agency** **\*\*IN\-OFFICE REQUIREMENT 3 DAYS/WEEK \- MUST BE WITHIN A 90 MINUTE COMMUTE TO PLAINSBORO, NJ CLIENT OFFICE\*\*** **Company Description:** Merkle, a dentsu company, powers the experience economy. For more than 35 years, the company has put people at the heart of its approach to digital business transformation. As the only integrated experience consultancy in the world with a heritage in data science and business performance, Merkle delivers holistic, end\-to\-end experiences that drive growth, engagement, and loyalty. Merkle's expertise has earned recognition as a "Leader" by top industry analyst firms, in categories such as digital transformation and commerce, experience design, engineering and technology integration, digital marketing, data science, CRM and loyalty, and customer data management. With more than 16,000 employees, Merkle operates in 30\+ countries throughout the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. **ROLE PURPOSE** The **TEMPORARY Technical Project Manager** is the operational execution leader for Adobe Experience Cloud implementation workstreams for our Healthcare client \- serving as the bridge between solution architecture, delivery teams, and engagement leadership. This role owns day\-to\-day delivery coordination, sprint planning and execution, dependency management, and risk mitigation for assigned technical workstreams—ensuring that architectural designs are built as intended, on time, on budget, and to quality standards. **This role requires in\-office presence 3x per week at client offices in Plainsboro, NJ.** This role combines deep technical fluency with hands\-on project management discipline. You manage teams of 5\-15 technical professionals (engineers, data engineers, architects, QA), coordinate across distributed teams and time zones, remove blockers, and drive measurable progress against sprint commitments. You translate technical complexity into clear status communication for stakeholders while maintaining the trust and engagement of your delivery team. Essentially, this role operates at the intersection of technical execution and stakeholder clarity—converting solution designs into built, tested, deployed capabilities while keeping teams coordinated, risks visible, and stakeholders informed. **RESPONSIBILITY AREAS** **Sprint Planning \& Execution** -------------------------------- * Own sprint planning for assigned workstream(s); break down solution architecture and epics into well\-defined stories and tasks with clear acceptance criteria * Conduct rigorous story estimation with the delivery team; flag scope concerns and dependencies early * Maintain backlog discipline: prioritize work, manage scope changes, track velocity, and adapt plans based on delivery reality * Drive daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives; ensure ceremonies are efficient and action\-oriented * Track sprint metrics: velocity, on\-time delivery, defect escape rate, rework; identify trends and coaching opportunities * Manage sprint\-to\-sprint continuity: document decisions, carry forward blockers, and maintain momentum across sprints **Technical Team Leadership \& Coordination** --------------------------------------------- * Lead matrixed technical teams spanning engineers, data engineers, architects, QA, and other specialists; foster collaboration and accountability * Clarify technical requirements and design intent for the team; reduce ambiguity and unnecessary back\-and\-forth with architects or clients * Conduct regular 1:1s with team members; understand capacity, concerns, and growth opportunities; provide coaching and feedback * Coordinate across geographies and time zones; ensure synchronization and clear handoff protocols for distributed work **Dependency \& Blocker Management** ------------------------------------ * Maintain a comprehensive view of workstream dependencies: cross\-team, cross\-engagement, vendor, and client\-side * Identify and escalate blockers early; propose workarounds or mitigation strategies; drive resolution with urgency * Coordinate dependencies across parallel workstreams; align timing and handoffs to prevent downstream delays * Facilitate cross\-team sync meetings when dependencies require real\-time coordination or decision\-making * Track high\-risk dependencies; flag to engagement leadership for escalation if resolution is stalled **Quality \& Technical Standards** ---------------------------------- * Define and enforce acceptance criteria for all deliverables; ensure quality is non\-negotiable * Conduct or facilitate code/design reviews; ensure work aligns with architectural intent and technical standards * Partner with QA to ensure comprehensive test coverage; identify and track defects; manage rework efficiently * Maintain visibility into technical debt and archit ional lines * Coaching mindset: ability to mentor junior team members and help them grow into stronger technical professionals * Presence and credibility: command respect from both technical and non\-technical stakeholders ### **Problem\-Solving \& Adaptability** * Strong problem\-solving and critical thinking; ability to decompose complex challenges and drive to resolution * Comfort with ambiguity; ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information * Resilience under pressure; ability to maintain clarity and composure when facing timeline pressure or scope conflicts * Proactive mindset: identify issues early, propose solutions, and drive action without waiting for escalation **Preferred \& Differentiators** -------------------------------- * Direct experience managing Adobe Experience Cloud implementation workstreams (AEM migrations, AEP data implementations, AJO orchestration, CJA analytics) * Adobe Certified Professional or Developer certification * Experience in a consultancy, systems integrator, or services firm delivering large\-scale technology programs * Project management certification (PMI, Scaled Agile, or similar) * Hands\-on technical background (prior role as engineer, architect, or technical lead) * Experience managing distributed, global teams across time zones * Experience with change management and organizational adoption strategies * Familiarity with healthcare, pharmaceutical, financial services, or other regulated industries **Additional Information:** At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in\-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office. **The hourly pay range for this position is $65\.78 \- $87\.77\.** The hourly pay rate for the successful candidate is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Temporary employees are eligible for paid holidays in accordance with dentsu policy, as well as safe and sick time. This position is not eligible for any other benefits or other compensation. To begin the application process, please click on the "Apply" button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps. \#LI\-SG1 \#LI\-Hybrid **Location:** USA \- Remote \- New Jersey**Brand:** Merkle**Time Type:** Full time**Contract Type:** Temporary Dentsu is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We do this without regard to race, color, national origin, sex , sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religious practices and observances, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Dentsu is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to, among others, individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you need an accommodation because of a disability to search and apply for a career opportunity with us, please send an e\-mail to ApplicantAccommodations@dentsu.com by clicking on the link to let us know the nature of your accommodation request and your contact information. We are here to support you.

jobs.title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will advance machine learning capabilities that help detect and prevent abuse and fraud across Docusign products and services. Your work will support earlier identification of harmful behavior and risk\-based interventions. You will partner with Trust \& Safety, Fraud, Engineering, Product, Security, and Data teams to improve detection as abuse patterns evolve. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Trust \& Safety. **Responsibility*** Design, develop, evaluate, and deploy production ML models for fraud, spam, abuse, and other Trust \& Safety risks * Build risk and reputation scoring capabilities using behavioral, account, network, device, content, and other relevant signals * Translate detection problems into ML requirements, including labels, features, evaluation methods, and success criteria * Identify emerging abuse patterns and determine where ML, rules, or combined approaches improve detection * Develop model outputs that support flagging, throttling, verification, review, or blocking * Evaluate detection performance, false\-positive and false\-negative tradeoffs, and downstream risk impact * Establish model monitoring, retraining, and degradation detection practices * Partner with Trust \& Safety and Fraud experts on adversary behavior and enforcement impact, and with Engineering, Data, Product, and Security on data and production integration * Establish technical direction and foundational ML practices for Trust \& Safety and Fraud **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience and 8\+ years of related industry experience * Experience developing, deploying, operating, and measuring production machine learning models, including supervised and unsupervised learning, classification, risk prediction, anomaly or behavioral detection, and model evaluation * Experience applying ML to fraud detection, spam or abuse detection, cybersecurity, Trust \& Safety, anti\-abuse, risk, or another adversarial domain * Experience solving detection problems with incomplete or evolving signals, labels, requirements, or abuse patterns, including changing attacker behavior, class imbalance, noisy labels, model degradation, and false\-positive and false\-negative tradeoffs * Experience with C\#, Java, or Go, and ML frameworks, data processing, feature engineering, automation, and reproducible experimentation, training, and validation * Experience building data and feature pipelines using large\-scale behavioral, event, or transactional datasets, including streaming or high\-volume event processing * Experience deploying and serving ML models in distributed systems, integrating outputs into production applications or decisioning systems, and balancing system design, scalability, reliability, latency, throughput, and model performance * Experience with MLOps across the model lifecycle, including deployment, monitoring, retraining, versioning, degradation detection, and model health, and deploying ML workloads using Docker and Kubernetes * Experience with observability technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or Jaeger, and Azure and Azure DevOps or equivalent * Experience defining model success criteria, measuring detection or risk improvements, communicating ML tradeoffs, and collaborating with Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, and domain experts **Preferred** * Experience building ML systems for spam detection, messaging abuse, account abuse, payment fraud, account takeover, identity risk, reputation scoring, or platform integrity * Experience developing account, entity, or behavioral risk\-scoring models that combine multiple signals * Experience detecting attackers who adapt to controls and integrating ML outputs into automated prevention, enforcement, or risk\-based decisioning workflows * Experience incorporating analyst decisions, investigations, or enforcement outcomes into model development * Experience improving heuristic detection systems through ML or hybrid rules\-and\-ML approaches * Experience establishing or scaling ML capabilities within a fraud, security, or Trust \& Safety organization **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations: Washington, Maryland, New Jersey and New York (including NYC metro area): $178,900\.00 \- $262,825\.00 base salary This role is also eligible for the following: * Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre\-established sales goals. Non\-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance. * Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Work Authorization Notice:** Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Applicants must already be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time, permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship. **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation** Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com. If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

jobs.description: **Overview:** Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. The 2,000\+ employees of Draper tackle important national challenges with a promise of delivering successful and usable solutions. From military defense and space exploration to biomedical engineering, lives often depend on the solutions we provide. Our multidisciplinary teams of engineers and scientists work in a collaborative environment that inspires the cross\-fertilization of ideas necessary for true innovation. For more information about Draper, visit www.draper.com. **Job Description Summary:** Engineering Student internships support the research and development of new or existing microsystems and advanced materials (hardware, software, components, and materials/chemistry research and modeling) or may assist in sustaining and improving the quality processes across the full engineering and manufacturing life cycle. Student interns will contribute to projects in various engineering disciplines such as computer hardware or software design and development, electro\-optical design, optical and thermal model development, bioengineering, materials testing, chemistry, electrical system design, hardware assembly, testing, etc. Student interns will test and evaluate products, systems, or components and work with various applications such as LabVIEW, MATLAB, SolidWorks, COMSOL, ANSYS, Mentor Graphics, Python, and GitLab. Student interns collaborate with engineers or technicians to build and test systems, hardware, or components on various projects. They may also be involved in ensuring quality products are produced and quality procedures are upheld.**Job Description:** **Duties/Responsibilities** --------------------------- * Design, develop, and enhancement engineering solutions for challenging problems. * Implement, test, perform analysis, and provide documentation support. * Generate and present test reports including plots, tables, evaluation criteria, and conclusions from data collected and analyzed throughout the test process. * Complete assignments designed to develop a practical knowledge of processes, procedures, equipment, facilities, and systems as well as their interrelationships within engineering disciplines. * Performs other duties as assigned. **Program Requirements** ------------------------ * Enrolled in an accredited full\-time undergraduate or graduate degree program required. * There is flexibility regarding hours and program duration based on applicant’s school schedule and availability. **Skills/Abilities** -------------------- * Excellent written and oral communication skills. * Excellent work ethic with the ability to work independently or in a team environment. * Ability to adapt to ever\-changing environments, risks, and vulnerabilities. * Strong computer skills including MS Word, PowerPoint and Excel. **Additional Job Description:** **Responsibilities** The student will be a part of a team that designs, models, and tests complex multi\-physics devices, microsystems, and materials and systems. An example research area would be radiation effects in semiconductor electronics. In addition, the candidate should have an interest in a wide variety of other areas such as MEMS sensors, space systems and electro\-optics. **Qualifications** The ideal candidate will be seeking a degree in electrical engineering, nuclear engineering, physics, materials science, chemistry, or a related field. jobs.title: 2027 Summer Engineering Internship
jobs.description: About Us: We are a diversified designer, supplier, installer, and servicer of engineered air systems and components for the industrial, life sciences, manufacturing, and mission critical markets. Our air treatment systems help control all internal conditions, including temperature, relative humidity, cleanliness, and ventilation.
