jobs.title: Network Operator
jobs.description: #### **About Torus** Torus is headquartered in Utah and is expanding manufacturing at our 545,000\-square\-foot facility in Salt Lake City called GigaOne. **We are** **the world’s first mesh energy infrastructure, uniting communities through resilient, sustainable, and intelligent power.** We design, engineer, manufacture, install, and support our systems end\-to\-end, standing behind them throughout their lifecycle. Torus systems help reduce costs, lower emissions, and protect facilities from outages, while strengthening the security and reliability of the broader utility grid. Torus is committed to American manufacturing, engineering excellence, and building energy systems that last. Torus has raised over $267 million from investors like Magnetar, Mercado, ICONIQ and Origin Ventures. The investments are helping to accelerate deployment of modular power plants across utilities, data centers, and industrial sectors. This investor confidence reflects the strength of our team, technology as well as the scale of the problem we are solving. At Torus, you will be part of something larger than a single product or technology. Your work will help build energy infrastructure that supports and strengthens our electrical grid, critical systems, industry, and communities for decades to come. We value accountability, collaboration, and clear thinking. We are looking for people who want to solve hard problems and build things that matter. #### **About the Role** We are seeking an experienced, mission\-driven **Network Operator** to join Torus Overwatch. As a member of Torus Overwatch Command, you help protect the system visibility, reliability, and uptime our customers depend on. You investigate alerts, execute response procedures, coordinate with Grid Operators to maintain and restore service, and partner with field service to resolve issues requiring on\-site support. This role requires disciplined execution, clear communication, and sound judgment to recognize when an issue needs escalation beyond documented procedures. As our systems evolve, you help refine the playbooks and strengthen the practices that keep our operations reliable. #### **Who You Are** You keep the fleet online. You know that every system Torus operates depends on the network to be seen, controlled, and kept safe, so you treat uptime as a safety function, not a convenience. You're calm when alarms stack up, and you decide quickly what matters most: safety first, then availability, then performance. You catch degradation before it becomes an outage, you never make a change that hasn't been approved, and you escalate with the evidence the next tier needs. You hold your shift to a high bar for accuracy and documentation, and you make the people around you better at protecting the systems we all depend on. #### **Responsibilities** * Execute network and infrastructure alert responses within documented procedures across our sites, building toward independent diagnosis. * Perform system and alert analysis across network fabric and connected infrastructure (switches, CRAC and chiller loops, ATS, site monitoring sensors). * Coordinate with Grid Operators on uptime, and field service for hands\-on\-site fixes. * Partner with engineering teams to build and follow runbooks during incidents, and escalate per established playbooks when something falls outside documented procedure. * Participate in on\-call rotations with senior support. * Monitor system health through existing dashboards, flag anomalies, and keep tickets and logs complete and current. * Manage your own task list and meet assigned response windows. * Communicate alert status clearly at every handoff. * Help build and refine the playbooks and procedures you work from as our systems and tooling mature. * Ask questions and seek feedback actively as you build independent judgment. #### **Required Experience** * 4\+ years in network operations or a NOC environment, with some hands on configuration exposure * Solid grasp of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, VLANs, routing and switching basics, and common troubleshooting patterns * Proven experience executing documented procedures precisely, and recognizing when a situation falls outside them * Hands\-on experience with network monitoring and ticketing platforms * Clear written and verbal communication for shift handoffs and status updates * Must work on a rotating schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays #### **Preferred Experience** * CCNP or similar certification in progress or completed * Exposure to compute or infrastructure systems, such as servers, cooling, or power distribution, in addition to networking * Experience in a multi site or distributed network environment * Familiarity with change control processes (ITIL or similar) * Comfortable working where procedures and tooling are still evolving, and interest in helping shape them * Interest in growing into roles with broader technical scope and ownership #### **Additional Details** **Background Check** All candidates are subject to a background check. **Location \+ Travel** The role is hybrid remote with regular onsite work at our GigaOne warehouse in Salt Lake City (air\-conditioned). May require occasional onsite work at our South Salt Lake HQ Warehouse and/or Springville R\&D Warehouse (air\-conditioned and non air\-conditioned). **Schedule** Full\-Time, Salaried (Requires rotational on\-call work including nights and weekends.) **Compensation** $80,000\-100,000 (Note: We have the flexibility to hire at different levels, which may impact the corresponding pay range.) **Work Authorization** Applicants must already have the legal authorization to work in the US without requiring any employer sponsorship. **Physical Requirements** * Regularly operates a computer and other peripheral office equipment such as a printer or mouse. * When on the production floor, required to don personal protective equipment to include, but not limited to ear protection, gloves, eye protection and/or safety helmet. * When on the production floor, ability to observe, detect and respond to audible and visual machine malfunction warnings. * Ability to communicate information so others can understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. * Must report to work reliably and with the ability to use full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute your job. * Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required. #### **Our Perks \& Benefits** Benefits eligibility is based on employment status. Financial * Employee Rewards Package including equity * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan * Torus paid life and AD\&D Insurance with options to purchase additional coverage * Voluntary short\- and long\-term disability insurance Health \& Wellness * Health Benefits Package: Choice between traditional PPO or HSA\-eligible medical plans with Torus covering 50% of medical premiums; Dental insurance; and Vision insurance * Plan participants have access to telehealth services, mental health support and coaching, and exclusive discounts on brands, dining, entertainment, and more. Time Off * Unlimited discretionary PTO or 10 days annual PTO * 10 paid company holidays * Waiting period\-free 100% paid parental leave Culture \& Community * Regular company\-wide offsites to showcase our progress and learnings. A time to step back, think strategically, and work on the business together. * Team members receive Torus branded gear * Peer Recognition Program * Fully stocked break rooms with free snacks and drinks. Because great work deserves great fuel. Torus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Torus participates in E\-Verify. Once you accept a job offer, we will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from your Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. \#li\-lw \#li\-hybrid

initiatives. * Develop your own resources to solve problems and provide imaginative solutions to a broad range of difficult problems, producing significant results. * Analyze recurring equipment repair on malfunctioning equipment down to the component level, as needed. * Take a lead role in resolving process issues and participate in yield investigations. * Use sound judgment in resolving problems, carrying out assignments, and making recommendations. * Participate in and lead/direct ERT/Safety events in the absence of supervision. * Ensure all required parts are on order and follow up high\-complexity technical projects. * Be recognized as a technical expert, demonstrating proficiency in more than one major production or test area. * Interface with Production, Process, Facility, and support functions to identify and resolve production equipment\-related issues, providing technical guidance to lower\-level technicians. * Act independently to determine methods and procedures for new assignments. * Work in a fab clean\-room environment. **Job Requirements** -------------------- **Must Have:** * Associate of Science degree with an emphasis in Electronics. This leader owns the engineering function responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating production\-grade AI agents, multi\-agent systems, and agentic workflows that transform how teammates and clients interact with the Firm. This is a highly technical player\-coach leadership role that combines executive organizational leadership with deep hands\-on engineering expertise. The Senior Director leads the engineering function, establishes technical direction, drives work planning and execution, and serves as the ultimate escalation point for architecture and engineering decisions across the agentic engineering portfolio. The successful candidate will bring extensive experience building large\-scale software and AI systems, including expertise in Python, modern systems languages such as Go, agentic frameworks, LLM orchestration, retrieval architectures, and enterprise AI platform engineering. This leader will be responsible for shipping production agentic systems, not simply defining roadmaps, ensuring all solutions meet Truist standards for security, scalability, resiliency, observability, governance, and regulatory compliance. The Senior Director partners closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Risk, and executive leadership teams to translate business strategy into enterprise\-scale AI capabilities while building and mentoring a world\-class team of agentic engineers.**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time. 1\. Lead the Agentic Engineering function, providing executive leadership, organizational design, technical governance, delivery accountability, and talent leadership across all agentic engineering initiatives. 2\. Own the technical direction for Forge agentic solutions, establishing architecture standards, engineering patterns, and development practices for enterprise AI agents and multi\-agent systems. 3\. Drive work planning, prioritization, execution management, and delivery outcomes across the agentic engineering organization, ensuring teams consistently deliver high\-quality production systems aligned to business commitments. 4\. Serve as the final engineering authority for architecture decisions, engineering standards, and critical code review escalations across the agentic engineering portfolio. 5\. Design and govern enterprise patterns for agent orchestration, tool invocation, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), memory management, prompt architecture, workflow automation, reasoning frameworks, evaluation pipelines, observability, and operational support. 6\. Lead the engineering strategy for enterprise agent platforms including Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and other emerging agentic technologies required to support the Forge roadmap. 7\. Partner with Product, Technology, Security, Risk, Architecture, and Data leaders to ensure AI solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, and aligned to enterprise priorities. 8\. Build and mentor a high\-performing engineering organization through hiring, performance management, succession planning, coaching, career development, and technical leadership. 9\. Establish and enforce engineering excellence standards including software craftsmanship, testing strategies, release management, architecture review, secure development practices, operational readiness, and reliability engineering. 10\. Drive engineering execution across complex cross\-functional initiatives involving application engineering, platform engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, cyber security, and enterprise architecture teams. 11\.Champion engineering rigor through measurable quality controls, system reliability objectives, operational metrics, and continuous improvement practices. 12\. Evaluate emerging AI nuous learning, and responsible AI development across the organization **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 1\. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, a related field, or equivalent education, training and work\-related experience. 2\. Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in technology operations. 3\. Broad leadership and management experience leading complex technology operations teams. 4\. Proven ability to manage complex operational initiatives across multiple teams. **Preferred Qualifications** 1\. Experience leading enterprise Agentic Engineering, AI Platform Engineering, Applied AI, Intelligent Automation, or Emerging Technology organizations. 2\. Deep expertise in multi\-agent systems, agent orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering, reasoning architectures, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), memory systems, agent evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. 3\. Experience building production AI applications using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Google Vertex AI Agent Engine, or similar platforms. 4\. Experience operating enterprise\-scale AI platforms supporting thousands of users and mission\-critical business processes. 5\. Strong understanding of AI governance, model risk management, responsible AI principles, AI security controls, and enterprise AI operating models. 6\. Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards, mentor senior engineers and engineering leaders, and build a culture of technical excellence. 7\. Experience delivering solutions across cloud\-native ecosystems using Azure and modern DevOps, platform engineering, and software delivery practices. 8\. Experience driving architecture modernization and transformation initiatives within large enterprises. 9\. Experience in financial services, fintech, cybersecurity, or other heavily regulated industries. 10\. Demonstrated participation in industry forums, technology communities, open\-source initiatives, vendor partnerships, or executive technology councils. The annual base salary for this position is $240,000 \- $360,000 **General Description of Available Benefits for Eligible Employees of Truist Financial Corporation:** All regular teammates (not temporary or contingent workers) working 20 hours or more per week are eligible for benefits, though eligibility for specific benefits may be determined by the division of Truist offering the position. For more details on Truist’s generous benefit plans, please visit our Benefits site. Depending on the position and division, this job may also be eligible for Truist’s defined benefit pension plan, restricted stock units, and/or a deferred compensation plan. As you advance through the hiring process, you will also learn more about the specific benefits available for any non\-temporary position for which you apply, based on full\-time or part\-time status, position, and division of work. ***Truist is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, color, religion, citizenship or national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other classification protected by law. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Umain** --------------- Umain, part of Eidra, is a digital product consultancy with nearly 200 engineers, designers, and product strategists. We partner with companies including McDonald’s, Polestar, Heineken, Rijksmuseum, Spotify, and Philips Hue to shape, build, and scale the products and platforms their businesses and customers rely on. We work in small, senior teams, staying with a product from its first idea through launch and beyond. Umain is growing its AI engineering team in the US. Our AI engineers around the world design, prototype and build AI\-powered tools and software that change how clients work, from advanced GenAI workflows and custom agents to production\-ready AI applications. You'll join a global team of more than 30 AI engineers across Sweden, the Netherlands, Norway, and North America, working alongside strategy consultants, marketers, data experts and designers. This full time role is based in Chicago at our West Loop office. As part of Umain's expanding U.S. footprint, you'll help establish our reputation for engineering excellence, strategy, and delivery in the American market. You must be in Chicago or willing to relocate to be considered for this role as we require a minimum of 3 days in\-office per week. **Your role** ------------- As an AI Engineer at Umain, you’ll build the next generation of AI\-powered products, workflows, and agents for our clients, combining strong software engineering fundamentals and full\-stack product thinking with modern AI capabilities. Your work will range from integrating LLMs and vision models to architecting agents, building scalable pipelines and experimenting with new techniques. You’ll turn ambiguous ideas into robust solutions, evaluate where AI truly adds value and help clients understand what is possible, feasible, and responsible—all while playing an active role in shaping our growing AI practice. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Partner with clients to clarify their challenges, decide whether AI is the right answer and assess feasibility and risk, including data security, privacy, licensing, and responsible AI. * Design, prototype, build, and ship AI\-powered applications, workflows, and agents for clients ranging from start\-ups to global enterprises. * Architect agentic systems, including context management, memory, orchestration, and the tools, skills, and MCP integrations agents rely on. * Select, integrate, and adapt foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others). Fine\-tune or combine them when off\-the\-shelf options fall short. * Design around model limitations in both the architecture and the product's UX. Apply techniques like retrieval, chunking, embeddings, and redlining, and debug AI systems when they misbehave. * Build evaluation and observability into everything you ship. Use stochastic test cases, trace\-based analysis, and tools to benchmark and monitor models, prompts, and agents. * Build the software, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP, or AWS) that keep AI products running reliably at scale. * Own parts of project delivery, communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and lead client and internal workshops. * Bring technical credibility to new business. You'll join pitches as our AI expert, shape proposals and RFP responses, and help prospective clients see what's possible. * Help define Umain's AI offerings and grow the competence through internal frameworks, playbooks, knowledge sessions, and engineering standards. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Partner with clients to clarify their challenges, decide whether AI is the right answer and assess feasibility and risk, including data security, privacy, licensing, and responsible AI. * Design, prototype, build, and ship AI\-powered applications, workflows, and agents for clients ranging from start\-ups to global enterprises. * Architect agentic systems, including context management, memory, orchestration, and the tools, skills, and MCP integrations agents rely on. * Select, integrate, and adapt foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others). Fine\-tune or combine them when off\-the\-shelf options fall short. * Design around model limitations in both the architecture and the product's UX. Apply techniques like retrieval, chunking, embeddings, and redlining, and debug AI systems when they misbehave. * Build evaluation and observability into everything you ship. Use stochastic test cases, trace\-based analysis, and tools to benchmark and monitor models, prompts, and agents. * Build the software, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP, or AWS) that keep AI products running reliably at scale. * Own parts of project delivery, communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and lead client and internal workshops. * Bring technical credibility to new business. You'll join pitches as our AI expert, shape proposals and RFP responses, and help prospective clients see what's possible. * Help define Umain's AI offerings and grow the competence through internal frameworks, playbooks, knowledge sessions, and engineering standards. **What you bring** ------------------ * Approximately 8 years engineering experience that includes at least 4 years building AI\-powered systems, or equivalent hands\-on experience shipping AI in production systems. * Hands\-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, prompt and context engineering, retrieval setups, fine\-tuning, and model evaluation. * Experience building agents, including memory, tool use, and orchestration, with at least one modern agent framework. * Experience integrating AI services such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Meta models. * Strong software engineering skills in TypeScript and/or Python, including real backend systems and data pipelines. * Full\-stack product thinking: frontend or backend experience outside the traditional AI field, and the ability to build end to end. * Proven experience deploying and running scalable applications in Azure, GCP, or AWS. * Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and modern DevOps practices. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, LevelPlay
jobs.description: ### **The opportunity** Unity LevelPlay is a leading mediation platform for game developers, sitting at the heart of Unity's Grow business. LevelPlay helps thousands of mobile game developers maximize ad revenue across the world's largest ad networks, combining real\-time bidding, advanced revenue optimization, and deep analytics to power monetization for many of the top\-grossing mobile games globally. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape the future of the platform. This is a senior individual contributor role with outsized scope: you'll drive strategic bets that span the mediation stack, from auction dynamics and bidding infrastructure to publisher\-facing tooling and cross\-platform integrations, and influence how Unity's mediation ecosystem evolves over the next several years. You'll operate as a thought partner to product and engineering leadership, and your decisions will directly impact revenue for developers around the world and for Unity itself. ### **What you'll be doing** * Help shape the product vision and future strategy for the LevelPlay mediation platform, and own the roadmap for core areas from definition and planning through launch and iteration * Drive high\-stakes platform decisions on auction mechanics, bidding vs. waterfall dynamics, network integrations, and revenue optimization, grounded in data and marketplace understanding * Partner deeply with engineering, data science, design, and monetization teams to ship at scale, with strict latency and reliability demands * Engage directly with top publishers and ad network partners to understand needs, validate direction, and represent the voice of the developer in strategic decisions * Align stakeholders across Unity's Grow and Create divisions to deliver a unified experience * Mentor and up\-level PMs across the LevelPlay team, raising the bar for strategic product decision\-making ### **What we're looking for** * Extensive product management experience, with a track record of operating at principal level or equivalent: shaping strategy, not just executing it * Deep domain expertise in ad tech: mediation, in\-app bidding, programmatic auctions, ad networks, or adjacent marketplace/monetization systems * Demonstrated success owning platform products end to end, from definition through launch, iteration, and scale * Strong analytical rigor, including comfort with experimentation, marketplace metrics (ARPDAU, eCPM, fill rate), and making revenue\-impacting decisions under uncertainty * Experience partnering with ML and data science teams to bring models, signals, or optimization features into production * Exceptional stakeholder leadership: able to align executives, engineers, and external partners, and guide teams through ambiguity to impactful outcomes * A track record of driving decisions independently and with conviction, grounded in your own analysis * Experience in mobile gaming or with mobile developer ecosystems ### **You might also have** * Hands\-on experience with ad mediation platforms * Background in auction theory, machine learning\-driven optimization, or real\-time bidding systems * Experience with SDK\-based products and an understanding of the mobile ad lifecycle, including privacy frameworks (e.g. ATT, Privacy Sandbox), latency optimization, and network adapter strategy Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location: Zone A: $175,200 \- $262,800 USD gross Zone B: $198,000 \- $297,000 USD gross Zone C: $222,500 \- $333,700 USD gross *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.* **Benefits** At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well\-being and work\-life balance. Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status. While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance \| Commute subsidy \| Employee stock ownership \| Competitive retirement/pension plans \| Generous vacation and personal days \| Support for new parents through leave and family\-care programs \| Office food snacks \| Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support \| Employee Resource Groups \| Global Employee Assistance Program \| Training and development programs \| Volunteering and donation matching program **Life at Unity** Unity \[NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. For more information, please visit www.unity.com. *Unity is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and celebrate our employees across age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. Our differences are strengths that enable us to support the growing and evolving needs of our customers, partners, and collaborators. If you have a disability that means there are preparations or accommodations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please fill out* *this form* *to let us know.* *This position requires the incumbent to have a sufficient knowledge of English to have professional verbal and written exchanges in this language since the performance of the duties related to this position requires frequent and regular communication with colleagues and partners located worldwide and whose common language is English.* *This posting is intended to fill an existing vacancy, and we are committed to providing applicants with updates throughout the hiring process in accordance with applicable law.* *Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Unity does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Unity will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Unity.* *Your privacy is important to us. Please take a moment to review our**Prospect* *and**Applicant* *Privacy Policies. Should you have any concerns about your privacy, please contact us at DPO@unity.com.*

jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI/ML Engineering
jobs.description: ### **JOB SUMMARY:** The Senior Manager, AI/ML Engineering will lead a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, data engineers, and developers to design and deploy enterprise\-scale optimization and decision\-intelligence solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. This role combines strategic vision with hands\-on technical leadership, serving as an enterprise subject matter expert for machine learning, optimization and mathematical programming while guiding teams to deliver production\-ready systems that enhance business performance and guest experiences. Key responsibilities include managing a portfolio of applied AI/ML initiatives across personalization, marketing, dynamic pricing, revenue management, workforce planning, digital experiences, and other complex decision domains; translating strategy into execution; embedding responsible AI and decision\-system practices; and fostering a culture of innovation. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative leader, committed to developing talent, championing technical rigor, and enabling AI,ML and optimization at scale across the organization. ### **MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Strategic Leadership \& Enterprise Enablement** * Provide strategic and technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, data engineers, and developers, setting direction and aligning work to enterprise priorities while promoting collaboration, continuous learning, and high\-impact delivery. * Establish and communicate a clear enterprise vision, technical roadmap, and operating model for optimization and decision intelligence, balancing immediate business needs with long\-term capability development. * Direct technical teams by defining objectives, decision rights, technical standards, architectural guardrails, and measurable outcomes. * Guide and mentor technical teams through problem formulation, architecture, model design, solution trade\-offs, and production readiness in support of machine learning, optimization and mathematical programming. * Coordinate initiative sequencing, resource needs, dependencies, and delivery risks across product, engineering, data, and business teams, removing roadblocks and ensuring execution remains aligned with scope, schedule, and business outcomes. **Applied AI/ML \& Optimization Development** * Provide technical direction and oversight for AI/ML and optimization development, architecture, code quality, reusable libraries, reference architectures, and product\-lifecycle best practices to ensure scalable, maintainable, secure, and production\-ready solutions. * Engage with internal and external partners to gather requirements and collaborate with engineers, architects, product leaders, and business stakeholders to design robust solutions across domains. * Lead end\-to\-end problem formulation, model design, algorithm selection, prototyping, benchmarking, and validation across optimization, machine learning, and decision science. Apply advanced analytical and AI/ML techniques to integrate predictive and prescriptive modeling, experimentation, simulation, real\-time signals, and business constraints into scalable decision systems that improve business outcomes and adapt over time. * Establish delivery and operational governance, remove cross\-team roadblocks, and track quality, reliability, adoption, and business\-impact KPIs. Define standards for model and solver monitoring, performance degradation and drift detection, incident response, and continuous improvement. **AI/ML Technical Strategy** * Define and drive the strategy and prioritized portfolio for optimization products and decision systems, balancing near\-term business outcomes with long\-term platform evolution and determining where capabilities should be built, bought, reused, or standardized across personalization, marketing, dynamic pricing, revenue management, workforce planning, digital experiences, and resource allocation. * Evaluate open\-source and commercial solvers, frameworks, and platforms across performance, cost, scalability, licensing, and security; direct cross\-functional alignment on technology choices, investments, standards, and responsible\-AI requirements, and communicate recommendations, trade\-offs, and program status to senior leadership. * Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health \& Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. * Performs other duties as assigned. ### **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Hands\-on experience designing and developing production decision systems, including data and feature pipelines, APIs and services, cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, containerization, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining or recalibration processes. * Deep expertise in statistical inference, supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, clustering and segmentation, time\-series forecasting, probabilistic modeling, predictive analytics, and model ensembling. * Demonstrated expertise formulating and solving large\-scale decision problems using linear, mixed\-integer, nonlinear, stochastic, robust, and/or multi\-objective optimization; experience with constraint programming, decomposition, simulation, heuristics, and learning\-based decision methods. * Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using optimization modeling frameworks and one or more solver ecosystems such as Gurobi or CPLEX. * Experience integrating optimization with machine learning, forecasting, predictive models, personalization and recommendation systems, experimentation, simulation, or adaptive decision methods. * Proven ability to establish technical vision, influence and direct multidisciplinary teams without formal authority, drive cross\-functional alignment, and resolve complex technical and business decisions. * Track record of connecting technical solutions to tangible business value and managing a portfolio of initiatives across multiple business domains. * Storyteller comfortable presenting to executives and mentoring both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Hands\-on experience applying privacy, security, fairness, explainability, governance, and compliance principles in production AI/ML and optimization systems. * Advanced knowledge of product and delivery methodologies, with demonstrated success translating strategy into coordinated execution in fast\-paced, ambiguous, and matrixed environments. ### **EDUCATION:** * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or in a relevant applied quantitative field is required. ### **EXPERIENCE:** * 9\+ years’ experience in applied‑AI, data science or software‑engineering roles; * or equivalent combination of education and experience. jobs.title: Software and Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** =========================== This position is available within the University of Maryland’s Division of Information Technology (DIT). This position will interface with the network engineers day\-to\-day to design, plan, and implement well\-engineered software, network management and service support that enrich the MAX network productivity and reliability as well as support for the DNS “D” root services. The work will include support documentation, support for existing “C” lines of code, support for and expansion of the root server “D” while working closely with the DNS global root operators. This position will establish standard and repeatable solutions to address common software and data requirements. Regularly participate in engagements with network engineers to design, plan, and implement well\-engineered software utilities and tools that enrich network productivity and reliability. Regularly participate in conference calls and on emails with DNS root operators and discuss and reconcile disruptions within the global DNS environment and attend their operations meetings. The position will also assist in the support of the MAX server environment that supports the MAX network. \*\*This position is considered essential and may be required to work at the normal work location or an alternative location during a major catastrophic event, weather emergency, or other operational emergency to help maintain the continuity of University services.\*\* \*\*May be required to work evenings, nights, weekends, or different shifts for extended periods.\*\* Physical Demands: This position will require the racking and stacking of servers and network equipment on occasion with a maximum weight limit of 50 lbs. Must have the ability to walk short distances and drive a state vehicle. Licenses/Certifications: Valid driver's license to operate a state vehicle. **Minimum Qualifications** ========================== Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university. Experience: Three (3\) years of professional network design, research, implementation, and escalation support experience. Other: Additional work experience as defined above may be substituted on a year for year basis for up to four (4\) years of the required education. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, \& ABILITIES: Knowledge of core networking design and implementation over the WAN. Knowledge of scalable networks. Skill in oral and written communication. Skill in the use of Google Workspace. Ability to interpret and apply policies, procedures, regulations, and laws. jobs.title: OT Infrastructure Student Developer, St Pete
jobs.description: **Job Description:** The Operational Technology (OT) Infrastructure Student Developer supports the maintenance, development, and modernization of the University of South Florida's Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and Building Automation Systems (BAS). The student will work as part of a collaborative Agile/Scrum team responsible for supporting the university's HVAC and operational technology infrastructure. Current projects focus on migrating building automation systems from the legacy Alerton platform to the Tridium Niagara framework. This migration involves integrating field devices, configuring system communications, developing graphical user interfaces, validating data integrity, and supporting system functionality for campus operations personnel. The position offers exposure to real\-world IT and operational technology environments, including microcontroller integration, data visualization, software testing, and enterprise infrastructure systems that support critical campus operations. **ORGANIZATIONAL SUMMARY:** Located in the vibrant and diverse Tampa Bay region of Florida’s gulf coast, the University of South Florida (USF) is a Preeminent State Research University with campuses in Tampa, St. Petersburg and Sarasota\-Manatee. USF is one of the nation’s largest public universities, serving more than 50,000 students with an annual budget of $1\.8 billon. Over the past five years, USF has been the fastest\-rising university in the nation, public or private, on the U.S. News and World Report's list of best universities, which it ranks as the 44th best public university in America. USF is proud to be an innovating partner within the Tampa Bay region, listed by Forbes as the top emerging tech city in the country. USF Information Technology (USF IT) provides technology services and support for the University of South Florida. The IT team, led by the Vice President and CIO, provides the following services: Administrative Services, Client Support, Communication Services, Teaching and Learning, Analytics and Reporting, Mobile and Web Services, Consulting Services, Cybersecurity Service and Research Technologies. For more information, please visit: USF Information Technology **ADDITIONAL INFO FOR APPLICANTS:** The selected candidate must have current work authorization in the United States. This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship. **Duties and Responsibilities:** Assists and learns the migration of building automation and HVAC systems from Alerton to Tridium Niagara. Configure and integrate field devices, controllers, and equipment into the Niagara platform. Develop and maintain graphical user interface (GUI) pages and system visualizations for operators and technicians. Perform quality assurance (QA) testing to verify functionality, accuracy, and reliability of system integrations. Troubleshoot hardware, software, and communication issues within SCADA and Building Automation Systems. Support the monitoring and maintenance of operational technology infrastructure across campus facilities. Assist in validating device data, alarms, trends, and system performance metrics. Document configurations, testing procedures, and implementation processes. Participate in Agile and Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and team meetings. Collaborate with engineers, developers, and field technicians to identify and resolve system issues. Learn and apply industry best practices related to operational technology, industrial controls, and system integration. SCADA is user\-friendly and easy to understand and it’s an operator\-level platform. All field\-level devices are integrated into the computer level using our SCADA. So that it’s easy to track and operate from anywhere. **Overview of Work:** In the present phase, we are upgrading the SCADA from Alerton to Niagara software (which is in other terms an older version of software to a newer version of the software). **Tasks involved:** Integrating the devices from Alerton to Niagara software. Designing the graphic pages. Must be a current USF student. **IT Core Competencies:** Growth Mindset \- Takes ownership of personal growth and embr  2025, U.S. News \& World Report recognized USF with its highest overall ranking in university history, as a top 50 public university for the seventh consecutive year and as one of the top 15 best values among all public universities in the nation. Our first\-class benefits package includes medical, dental and life insurance plans, retirement plan options, employee and dependent tuition programs, generous leave, and hundreds of employee perks and discounts. **About USF** The University of South Florida is a top\-ranked research university serving approximately 50,000 students from across the globe at campuses in Tampa, St. Petersburg, Sarasota\-Manatee and USF Health. Here, we work to provide the employee benefits and service solutions that enable employees at our client companies to thrive throughout life’s moments. And this starts with ensuring that every one of our team members enjoys opportunities to succeed both professionally and personally. To enable this, we provide: * Award\-winning culture * Inclusion and diversity as a priority * Performance Based Incentive Plans * Competitive benefits package that includes: Health, Vision, Dental, Short \& Long\-Term Disability * Generous PTO (including paid time to volunteer!) * Up to 9\.5% 401(k) employer contribution * Mental health support * Career advancement opportunities * Student loan repayment options * Tuition reimbursement * Flexible work environments * ***All the benefits listed above are subject to the terms of their individual Plans*** **.** And that’s just the beginning… With 10,000 employees helping more than 39 million people worldwide, every role at Unum is meaningful and impacts the lives of our customers. Whether you’re directly supporting a growing family, or developing online tools to help navigate a difficult loss, customers are counting on the combined talents of our entire team. Help us help others, and join Team Unum today! **General Summary:** -------------------- The Assistant Vice President of CX Growth Analytics is responsible for leading a technical team that drives Demand Generation revenue growth and optimization. This leader serves as a strategic partner to leaders across marketing, sales, finance and the Go\-to\-Market Value Stream. The Growth Analytics team delivers the measurement, attribution, funnel intelligence, data strategy, and MarTech data pipeline capabilities that fuel strategic growth by identifying and prioritizing target accounts, optimizing marketing\-to\-sales pipeline performance, and quantifying marketing attribution. The leader must develop and grow a multidisciplinary team spanning Data Science, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, and Marketing Analytics Operations. Success requires deep B2B marketing analytics expertise, strong technical leadership, and the ability to leverage advanced analytics, AI, automation, and emerging technologies to advance analytics delivery and improve business performance. **Principal Duties and Responsibilities:** ========================================== **Growth Analytics Strategy, Measurement \& Funnel Intelligence** * Define and drive the growth analytics vision and strategy by advancing the data and analytical capabilities needed to identify and prioritize the addressable market, uncover growth opportunities, and optimize performance across the marketing\-to\-sales pipeline. * Translate buyer engagement data, pipeline activity, and sales outcomes into actionable and measurable insights; identify success patterns and opportunities that improve demand generation performance and sales conversion. * Establish shared goals, KPIs, and measurement frameworks across Marketing, Field Effectiveness, Sales, and Finance that provide consistent visibility into marketing\-to\-sales pipeline performance and enable optimization of buying group engagement, funnel progression, and conversion outcomes. * Model opportunity mix, pipeline conversion, and close ratios needed by segment to achieve annual sales premium targets and translate those requirements into actionable business goals. * Own and continuously advance the Marketing\-to\-Sales Pipeline attribution framework and methodologies, ensuring accurate measurement of influenced and incremental sales premium while defining and refining the engagement sufficiency thresholds associated with higher conversion and close rates than non\-influenced opportunities. * Advance funnel intelligence from a reporting capability to a core planning and decision\-making tool that integrates sales seasonality, segment priorities, and funnel\-stage performance into media investments, business prioritization, and growth execution. * Assess the impact of AI\-powered search, discovery, and zero\-click behavior on buyer engagement and attribution; advance measurement approaches and analytical capabilities to adapt to changing digital consumption patterns. **Data Strategy \& Marketing Analytics Operations** * Lead the data strategy, data quality, and integration capabilities needed to produce consistent, trusted insights across the marketing\-to\-sales pipeline. * Aggregate and enrich internal and third\-party data to define the addressable market; and design data pipelines to identify and qualify engaged prospects and route them to the field in a measurable, actionable manner. * Own data and MarTech vendor relationships and budgets; evaluate and enhance data, automation, MarTech, and analytics capabilities that improve productivity, measurement, and business performance. **AI, Advanced Analytics and Technical Leadership** * Lead the transformation of analytics delivery through AI, automation, agentic workflows, and self\-service capabilities that improve scalability, productivity, and decision\-making. * Identify practical applications for LLMs, advanced modeling, machine learning, and automation, evaluating business value, technical feasibility, and governance requirements. * Provide technical direction across SQL, Python, statistical modeling, machine learning, data engineering, and business intelligence. * Review code and analytical methods, diagnose technical issues, and guide teams in developing reliable and maintainable solutions. **Team Leadership** * Build and lead a high\-performing team of data scientists, engineers, analysts, and marketing analytics operations specialists. * Develop technical and business capabilities through coaching, continuous learning, and career development. * Foster experimentation, accountability, collaboration, and strong business partnership. * Manage portfolio intake, prioritization, and delivery using agile methods and measurable pipeline outcomes. May perform other duties as required. **Job Specifications:** ======================= * Bachelor’s degree required, Master’s preferred * Degree or comparable experience in Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline. * 10\+ years of experience in Advanced Analytics or Technology, with a preference for experience in Marketing Analytics, Demand Generation Analytics, Sales Analytics, Revenue Operations, or a related function. * Strong technical expertise in SQL, Python, statistical modeling, machine learning, data visualization, and software engineering fundamentals, including solution design and testing. * Experience with large\-scale data and cloud platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, AWS, or GCP. * Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary technical teams; and demonstrated ability to review code, troubleshoot technical issues, evaluate analytical methods, and guide model and automation development. * Deep understanding of the B2B buying process; experience in finance or sales is a plus. * Proven strategic leadership and stakeholder engagement across cross\-functional environments; and demonstrated ability to align cross\-functional teams with revenue goals and metrics. * Ability to distill complex technical concepts into executive\-level insights. \~IN1 \#LI\-RA1 Unum and Colonial Life are part of Unum Group, a Fortune 500 company and leading provider of employee benefits to companies worldwide. Headquartered in Chattanooga, TN, with international offices in Ireland, Poland and the UK, Unum also has significant operations in Portland, ME, and Baton Rouge, LA \- plus over 35 US field offices. Colonial Life is headquartered in Columbia, SC, with over 40 field offices nationwide. Unum is an equal opportunity employer, considering all qualified applicants and employees for hiring, placement, and advancement, without regard to a person's race, color, religion, national origin, age, genetic information, military status, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or protected veteran status. jobs.title: Principal Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver. We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. **Your Role:** As a Principal Controls Engineer supporting Vantive’s Acute Therapies portfolio, you will be a key contributor in the model\-based development and verification of control algorithms for the PrisMax system. Your work will shape how the device interprets sensor inputs, controls electromechanical components, manages operating states, and supports safe, reliable therapy delivery. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role for an engineer who can take a complex control problem from system behavior and requirements through algorithm design, simulation, embedded implementation, and verification. You partner with Systems, Software, Hardware, Quality, and V\&V develop, verify, and document effective control solutions. **What You’ll Be Doing:** **Control Algorithm Design and Model\-Based Development** * Take technical ownership of complex PrisMax control algorithms, from expected system behavior and requirements through model architecture, implementation, integration, and lifecycle changes. * Develop and refine algorithms using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow for functions involving sensors, pumps, motors, valves, alarms, and therapy\-related calculations. * Apply control theory, dynamic\-system analysis, and sound engineering judgment to evaluate performance across intended operating conditions, component variation, and foreseeable faults. * Produce model\-generated code and partner with Software Engineering on interfaces, execution behavior, and integration into the device’s embedded software. **Verify Control Algorithms** * Define verification approaches for model\-based algorithms, including model review, simulation, coverage analysis, interface testing, and testing of integrated software or device behavior. * Develop and review test cases that challenge nominal, boundary, fault, and difficult\-to\-reproduce conditions; ensure expected results and acceptance criteria are clear. * Lead the technical analysis of test results and discrepancies, distinguish model defects from interface or integration issues, and drive robust resolutions. * Produce clear, traceable design and verification documentation that supports formal test execution, design reviews, and product development records. **Advance Modeling and Simulation** * Contribute to fit\-for\-purpose models of device components and system dynamics so control concepts can be evaluated before and alongside physical\-device testing. * Use model\-in\-the\-loop, software\-in\-the\-loop, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop methods where appropriate to explore design tradeoffs, characterize performance, and expose integration risks. * Document model assumptions, interfaces, limitations, and supporting evidence so simulation results can be interpreted and reused responsibly. **Strengthen Controls Engineering** * Lead reviews of algorithm designs and verification strategies, making tradeoffs and technical risks visible to cross\-functional partners. * Mentor engineers in model\-based design, controls analysis, testability, and disciplined problem solving while remaining directly involved in critical technical work. * Identify opportunities to improve the controls development practice by introducing reusable models, robust test techniques, and common design practices to enhance the quality and maintainability of control algorithms. **What You’ll Bring:** * Bachelor’s degree in Controls Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 6\+ years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on development of control algorithms for embedded electromechanical products. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree or PhD in Controls, Electrical, Mechanical, Biomedical, Systems, or a related engineering discipline. * Demonstrated experience designing and testing executable control models using MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow, or a closely comparable model\-b  about this, our pay philosophy, and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview* Advanced jobs.title: Engineer III, Network Performance
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you’ll be doing...** Join Verizon as we continue to expand our industry\-leading network to improve the ways people, businesses, and things connect. As a RAN Performance engineer, you will provide technical expertise on a critical role involving network transformation, network service issues, network optimization, and maintenance. You will be responsible for providing support to keep things running smoothly and change the way that our customers live, work, and play. We are seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented RAN Performance Engineer / LTE and 5G RAN Performance Engineer to lead wireless network testing, field execution, parameter optimization, and node migration projects across multi\-vendor LTE and 5G networks (mmWave, C\-Band, DSS, and Clean NR). In this role, you will be responsible for optimizing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure seamless network quality and user experience. Customers expect our networks to perform at a high level all the time. That’s also where you come in. Additionally, you will investigate, evaluate and resolve network and data performance issues to ensure and reliable service for our customers. The work you’ll be doing will directly impact customer satisfaction and help keep us ahead of the competition. You are able to thrive in the rapidly evolving landscape of Artificial Intelligence AI platforms and leverage AI use wherever possible. * Performing optimization, troubleshooting, and maintenance of network systems and applications to identify overall system availability and performance. * Evaluating network coverage to find gaps, making recommendations to improve coverage, and helping to implement those recommendations. * Generating, driving, and updating problem\-tracking tickets via multiple systems and continuously improving business practices. * Indoor RF Coverage Assessments: Collecting scanner data, analyzing RSRP, SINR, and PCI pollution, and identifying coverage gaps or interference. * Analyze pre/post\- KPI performance, identifying and resolving critical RAN performance issues such as high call drop rates, low throughput, interference, and handoff failures. * Perform deep\-dive VoLTE/5G drive test analysis to enhance accessibility, retainability, MOS score, and minimize audio gaps. * Executing multi\-band LTE and 5G optimization * Implement RF shaping adjustments (mechanical/electrical tilt, azimuth changes) and parameter optimization to balance traffic and maximize capacity. * Evaluating service performance trends and isolating root cause of impacted services. * Performing field drive/walk testing and post processing \& analysis of logs of relevant technologies and Key Performance Indicators. Analyzing Layer 3 drive test data and coming up with optimization strategies. * Diagnosing and resolving in\-building system issues, collaborating with senior engineers to address customer problems. * Managing customer eFEMTO deployments: providing technical support, and serving as a primary point of contact for customer\-facing issues * Focusing on continuous improvements, network and capacity optimization * Coordinating technical investigations and testing with appropriate regional, area and HQ functions. * Providing technical analysis, troubleshooting and training assistance to markets and regions as requested * Optimizating 5G and LTE RAN networks using traditional and innovative means * Investigating and resolving customer complaints regarding services * New Cell Site integration support, including Small Cells and DAS (Indoor as well as Outdoor) systems ### **What we’re looking for...** Being the first one to encounter and solve a problem is enjoyable to you. You have a strong customer service orientation. You like to take ownership of an issue and resolve it successfully. You’re great at following an established process or procedure to complete tasks. Experience navigating and working well at all levels in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing network environment. You are dependable and enjoy supporting the rotational needs of a technical environment. You’ll need to have: * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Three or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience * Proven track record of team leadership, mentoring, and technical oversight. * Strong problem\-solving abilities in challenging field and environment scenarios. * Excellent communication skills for cross\-functional teamwork and technical presentations. * Willingness to travel up to approximately 25% of the time. Even better if you have one or more of the following: * A degree. * Expertise of 4G and 5G * Five or more years of hands\-on experience in RF field testing, optimization, and wireless network deployment. * Strong working knowledge of 3GPP standards across CDMA, EVDO, LTE, VoLTE, CBRS, and 5G (mmWave, C\-Band, DSS, Clean NR). * Proven experience with OEM platforms including Samsung, Nokia macro and small cell hardware. * Proficiency with field drive test tools and post\-processing software, such as TEMS, XCAL, XCAP, JDSU, WindCatcher, TrueCall, xLPT, IRIS, and Optis Analyzer. * Familiarity with RF planning and reporting tools like Atoll, MapInfo Professional and Google Earth Pro. * Experience with propagation model tuning and validation to ensure accurate coverage alignment between prediction models and real\-time drive/walk test or field data. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Automation Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description** **General Summary:** Vertex’s Automation of Machinery and Processes (AMP) Team is seeking a high\-impact leader to develop cutting\-edge manufacturing solutions for its Cell \& Genetic Therapies programs. This pivotal role is at the forefront of automating complex processes in one of the most dynamic and rapidly evolving fields in biotechnology. You will work with a passionate team of engineers, scientists, and innovators united by a shared mission: to push the boundaries of what’s possible in Cell \& Genetic Therapy. This critical position will lead an interdisciplinary engineering team in novel equipment \& systems development, vendor selection, equipment qualification, technology transfer, and continuous improvement to deliver robust and reliable manufacturing systems. **Key Duties and Responsibilities:** * Lead a team of equipment and automation engineers involved in the design, development, deployment, and qualification of custom automation equipment and operation technology systems used for the development and manufacture of cell and genetic therapies. * Lead Equipment, System, and Automaton Projects from concept through execution in a dynamic development environment. Ensures user requirements are clearly defined and translated into achievable and testable engineering requirements. * Manage and execute the development of mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for capital equipment. Define automation execution strategy from concept feasibility through commercial deployment. Present to senior leadership as required. * Responsible for active oversight of the equipment / system design and commissioning process. Collaborate with vendors to produce prototype and production parts. Perform engineering analyses and relevant physical testing on designs. * Utilize operations simulation tools to identify and quantify automation opportunities. * Ensures seamless integration of automation control systems into existing enterprise systems. * Provide hands\-on troubleshooting assistance to manufacturing in support of a rapid development cycle and manufacturing sustainability. * Collaborates with manufacturing engineering to define, manage, and continuously improve equipment performance, preventative maintenance plans, and spare parts lists/inventory. * Evaluate and recommend automation upgrades to existing equipment or systems. Prioritize projects and assign resources to complete projects on\-time and within budget. * Review and/or draft Equipment Drawings, Electrical Diagrams, System Manuals, Engineering Protocols and Reports, Validation Documentation, and other Quality System Documentation. * Develop departmental procedures for development and documentation of automated systems, from specifications through operational procedures. * Support Deviation Management, CAPA, and Change Control activities, as required. Serve as Automation SME to Quality, Manufacturing, and other Functions. Support manufacturing investigations, including OOSs, OOTs, RCAs, etc. * Execute assigned duties on time and within budget; proactively telegraph delays and other issues to relevant stakeholders. Comply with all regulatory, corporate, and Quality System policies and complete other projects and/or assignments as required. * **Knowledge and Skills:** * High degree of electromechanical aptitude with prior experience in designing and implementing automated precision manufacturing equipment, including integration of vision systems and robotics, in bioprocessing, medical device, pharmaceutical, automotive, semiconductor, or diagnostic systems. * Ability to organize and grow a team through organizational change and personnel development. * Experience with automation and equipment business case definition, vendor selection and management, automation and equipment design, development, commissioning, and validation. Experience developing and executing equipment strategy from concept to deployment. * Experience working with a variety of automation hardware, software and applications including, but not limited to, custom\-fabricated mechanical components and mechanisms, single\-use bioreactors and bioprocessing instruments, vision systems, robotics, AMR and AGV, control systems (PLC, DeltaV, PC), AI\-enabled systems, and related control system components, pneumatics, automated process instrumentation. * Proficiency in AI tools and applications with experience developing for lab and manufacturing applications. * Experience qualifying/validating/deploying manufacturing equipment and processes is required. Knowledge and experience in utilizing risk\-based approaches to validation process development and validation are highly advantageous. * Familiarity with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR 820, 21 CFR 211, and ICH Q7/8/9\. Knowledge of global GMP requirements governing device or combination products. * Familiarity with equipment safety standards and regulations including OSHA 19 CFR 1910, NFPA 70, NFPA 79, ISO 18849\-1\. * Strong interpersonal, project management, technical writing and presentation skills required. * Sense of urgency, ability to act/escalate promptly, and transparently communicate issues to involved stakeholders and management. * Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision, multi\-task, and support several projects simultaneously. * Knowledge of business applications such as MS Office, Veeva, Coupa. Must demonstrate strong interpersonal, presentation, and teamwork skills. * **Education and Experience:** * PhD in chemical engineering, computer science, automation engineering or related field and 5 years experience in life sciences, manufacturing, or engineering, or * Master's Degree in chemical engineering, computer science, automation engineering or related field and 6 years experience in life sciences, manufacturing, or engineering, or Bachelor's Degree in chemical engineering, computer science, automation engineering or related field and 8 years experience in life sciences, manufacturing, engineering * 10\-15% domestic \& international travel is expected. At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision\-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients. **Pay Range:** $166,000 \- $249,000 **Disclosure Statement:** The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job\-related factors permitted by law. At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market\-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week\-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more. **Flex Designation:** On\-Site Designated **Flex Eligibility Status:** In this **On\-Site** designated role, you will work **five days per week on\-site** with ad hoc flexibility. Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time. \#LI\-Onsite **Company Information** Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation. Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non\-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E\-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law. Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

jobs.description: We are looking for a talented and driven Full\-Stack Engineer to join our Data Products Enablement team. In this role, you will be at the intersection of modern data engineering and full\-stack application development, building the platforms, tools, and self\-service interfaces that empower our internal data consumers. You will work closely with data engineers, analytics engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to design, build, and maintain scalable data products powered by Snowflake. Your work will directly influence how teams across the organization discover, access, trust, and act on data. This is a high\-impact, hands\-on engineering role ideal for someone who thrives at the crossroads of data infrastructure and software engineering, and who is passionate about building products that make data radically more accessible Key Responsibilities **Platform \& Product Development** * Design and develop full\-stack data product features, including front\-end dashboards, APIs, and back\-end data pipelines, integrating seamlessly with Snowflake as the core data platform. * Build and maintain internal self\-service data portals and catalogues that enable business users to explore, request, and consume certified datasets without engineering intervention. * Architect RESTful and GraphQL APIs that surface Snowflake data assets to front\-end applications, partner systems, and embedded analytics tools. * Develop reusable UI components and micro\-frontends using modern JavaScript frameworks, adhering to accessibility and performance best practices. **Snowflake \& Data Engineering** * Collaborate on the design of data contracts and semantic layer definitions to provide consistent, trusted metrics to downstream consumers. **DevOps, Quality \& Collaboration** * Champion CI/CD best practices for both application and data code, maintaining robust automated test coverage (unit, integration, and end\-to\-end). * Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, contribute to sprint planning, and drive engineering excellence through code reviews, pair programming, and technical documentation. * Monitor production systems, triage incidents, and perform root\-cause analysis, ensuring high availability and SLA compliance across data product services. * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the team's technical knowledge base through design documents, runbooks, and internal tech talks. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 4–8 years of professional experience in software engineering, with at least 2 years directly involving data platform or data product development. * Demonstrated track record of delivering production\-grade, full\-stack applications with measurable business impact. * Proficiency in advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, recursive queries, QUALIFY) and Snowflake\-specific DDL/DML including Time Travel, Zero\-Copy Cloning, and Streams \&
